verses.text: We are closer to him than his jugular vein
Call upon Me; I will respond to you
When My servants ask you about Me, I am near
Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear
Whoever puts their trust in Allah, He is enough for them
Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest

action.en: Begin your study in Allah's name
action.hi: Padhaai Allah ke naam se shuru karo

detail.en: The very first revelation was “Read in the name of your Lord who created.”
detail.hi: Sabse pehli wahi thi: “Apne Rab ke naam se padho jisne paida kiya.”

action.hi: Allah se ilm mein izaafa maango

detail.en: Allah taught the Prophet ﷺ to say: “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
detail.hi: Allah ne Nabi ﷺ ko sikhaaya: “Rabbi zidni ‘ilma.”

action.en: Put in the effort; results are with Allah
action.hi: Mehnat poori karo, natija Allah par

detail.en: A person gets nothing except what they strive for.
detail.hi: Insaan ko wahi milta hai jiski woh koshish karta hai.

action.hi: Tayyari karo, phir Allah par bharosa

detail.en: Once you have made up your mind, put your trust in Allah.
detail.hi: Jab iraada kar lo, toh Allah par bharosa karo.

action.hi: Jaanne waalon se poochho

detail.en: Ask the people of knowledge if you do not know.
detail.hi: Agar tum nahi jaante toh ilm waalon se poochh lo.

action.hi: Ilm ki qadr karo

detail.en: Are those who know equal to those who do not?
detail.hi: Kya jaanne wale aur na jaanne wale barabar ho sakte hain?

action.hi: Jaano ki ilm darje buland karta hai

detail.en: Allah raises in rank those who believe and those given knowledge.
detail.hi: Allah imaan waalon aur ilm waalon ke darje buland karta hai.

action.hi: Qur'an par ghaur karo

detail.en: Do they not reflect on the Qur'an?
detail.hi: Kya woh Qur'an par ghaur nahi karte?

action.en: Treat study as a path to Jannah
action.hi: Padhaai ko jannat ka raasta samjho

detail.en: Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for them a path to Paradise.
detail.hi: Jo ilm ki talaash mein raasta chale, Allah uske liye jannat ka raasta aasaan kar deta hai.

action.hi: Pehle oont baandho, phir bharosa

detail.en: A man asked whether to leave his camel untied and trust Allah. The Prophet ﷺ said: tie it, and trust.
detail.hi: Ek shakhs ne poocha ki oont khula chhod kar bharosa karoon? Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya: baandho, aur bharosa karo.

action.hi: Roz thoda thoda padho

detail.en: The deeds most loved by Allah are the ones done consistently, even if small.
detail.hi: Allah ko sabse pyaare woh amal hain jo lagaataar kiye jaayein, chahe thode hon.

action.en: Don't waste your health and free time
action.hi: Sehat aur khaali waqt zaaya na karo

detail.en: Two blessings many people lose out on: health and free time.
detail.hi: Do nematein jinmein bahut log ghaate mein hain: sehat aur fursat.

action.en: Learn the Qur'an and teach it
action.hi: Qur'an seekho aur sikhaao

detail.en: The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
detail.hi: Tum mein behtar woh hai jo Qur'an seekhe aur sikhaaye.

action.hi: Aisa ilm chhodo jo baad mein bhi kaam aaye

detail.en: When a person dies, their deeds stop except three, including knowledge that benefits others.
detail.hi: Insaan ke marne par amal ruk jaate hain siwaye teen ke, unmein se ek faayda dene wala ilm hai.

action.en: Ask Allah for understanding of the deen
action.hi: Allah se deen ki samajh maango

detail.en: When Allah wants good for someone, He gives them understanding of the religion.
detail.hi: Allah jiske saath bhalaai chahta hai, use deen ki samajh deta hai.

action.en: Remember marriage is built on love and mercy
action.hi: Yaad rakho, shaadi mohabbat aur rehmat par bani hai

detail.en: Allah placed between spouses affection and mercy, as one of His signs.
detail.hi: Allah ne miyan-biwi ke beech mohabbat aur rehmat rakhi, yeh uski nishaaniyon mein se hai.

action.en: Live together with kindness, even on hard days
action.hi: Mushkil dinon mein bhi achhe sulook se raho

detail.en: Live with them in kindness. If you dislike something, Allah may have put much good in it.
detail.hi: Unke saath bhalaai se raho. Agar koi baat napasand ho, toh ho sakta hai Allah ne usmein bahut bhalaai rakhi ho.

action.en: Choose the best words in a disagreement
action.hi: Behas mein bhi behtareen alfaaz chuno

detail.en: Tell My servants to say what is best, for Satan sows discord between people.
detail.hi: Mere bandon se kaho ki woh baat kahein jo sabse achhi ho, shaitaan logon mein phoot daalta hai.

action.hi: Sakhti ka jawaab bhalaai se do

detail.en: Repel evil with what is better, and an enemy may become a close friend.
detail.hi: Buraai ko behtar tareeqe se door karo, toh dushman bhi gehra dost ban sakta hai.

action.en: Bring in a fair family mediator when stuck
action.hi: Atak jaao toh ghar ka koi insaaf-pasand saalis bulao

detail.en: Appoint an arbiter from each family. If they want to reconcile, Allah will bring them together.
detail.hi: Dono khaandaanon se ek ek saalis muqarrar karo. Agar woh sulah chahein toh Allah unmein mel karwa dega.

action.en: Never forget the good you shared
action.hi: Saath guzri bhalaai kabhi na bhoolo

detail.en: Even at the hardest point, “do not forget graciousness between you.”
detail.hi: Sabse mushkil waqt mein bhi: “aapas mein ehsaan ko na bhoolo.”

action.en: Don't let one fault erase their good
action.hi: Ek kami ki wajah se saari achhaai mat bhoolo

detail.en: A believer should not hate a believing spouse: if one trait displeases you, another will please you.
detail.hi: Momin apni momina biwi se nafrat na kare: ek aadat bura lage toh doosri achhi lagegi.

action.en: Be at your best with your own family
action.hi: Apne ghar waalon ke saath sabse achhe bano

detail.en: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.
detail.hi: Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apne ghar waalon ke liye sabse behtar ho, aur main apne ghar waalon ke liye tum sab se behtar hoon.

action.hi: Apna gussa roko

detail.en: The strong one is not the wrestler, but the one who controls himself when angry.
detail.hi: Taaqatwar woh nahi jo pachhaad de, balki woh hai jo gusse mein khud ko qaabu rakhe.

action.hi: Chhoti si mehrbaani bhi sadqa hai

detail.en: Even the morsel you lift to your spouse's mouth is rewarded as charity.
detail.hi: Biwi ke munh mein daala hua niwaala bhi sadqa hai.

action.hi: Ghar ke kaam mein haath bataao

detail.en: Aisha (RA) said the Prophet ﷺ used to serve his family at home, until the time of prayer came.
detail.hi: Aisha (RA) ne farmaaya ki Nabi ﷺ ghar ke kaam-kaaj mein haath bataate the, yahan tak ki namaaz ka waqt ho jaata.

action.hi: Taqwa ko thaame raho

detail.en: Whoever is mindful of Allah, He makes a way out and provides from where they never expected.
detail.hi: Jo Allah se darta hai, Allah uske liye raasta nikaalta hai aur wahan se rizq deta hai jahan ka gumaan bhi na ho.

action.hi: Kasrat se istighfaar karo

detail.en: Ask your Lord's forgiveness; He sends rain and gives you wealth and children.
detail.hi: Apne Rab se maafi maango; woh baarish bhejega aur maal aur aulaad dega.

action.en: Thank Allah for what you have
action.hi: Jo mila hai uska shukr karo

detail.en: If you are grateful, I will surely give you more.
detail.hi: Agar tum shukr karoge toh main tumhe aur zyada doonga.

action.hi: Allah ki raah mein kharch karo

detail.en: Whatever you spend, He will replace it, and He is the best of providers.
detail.hi: Jo kuch tum kharch karte ho, woh uski jagah aur deta hai, aur woh sabse behtar rizq dene wala hai.

action.en: Trust Allah like the birds do
action.hi: Parindon ki tarah Allah par bharosa karo

detail.en: If you relied on Allah truly, He would provide for you as He provides for birds: they leave hungry and return full.
detail.hi: Agar tum sachcha bharosa karo toh Allah tumhe parindon ki tarah rizq de: subah bhooke jaate hain, shaam ko pet bhar laut-te hain.

action.en: Give charity; it doesn't reduce wealth
action.hi: Sadqa do, isse maal kam nahi hota

detail.en: Charity never decreases wealth.
detail.hi: Sadqa maal ko kabhi kam nahi karta.

action.hi: Rishtedaaron se taalluq jode raho

detail.en: Whoever wants their provision expanded and life extended, let them keep family ties.
detail.hi: Jo chahe ki uska rizq badhe aur umr lambi ho, woh rishte jode rakhe.

action.hi: Apne haath se kamaao

detail.en: No one eats better food than what they earned with their own hands.
detail.hi: Kisi ne apne haath ki kamaai se behtar khaana nahi khaaya.

action.hi: Din bhar Allah ko yaad karo

detail.en: Remember Me, and I will remember you.
detail.hi: Tum mujhe yaad karo, main tumhe yaad karunga.

action.hi: Har cheez usi se maango

detail.en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
detail.hi: Mujhe pukaaro, main tumhari sunoonga.

action.hi: Subah shaam uski tasbeeh karo

detail.en: Remember Allah often, and glorify Him morning and evening.
detail.hi: Allah ko kasrat se yaad karo, aur subah shaam uski tasbeeh karo.

action.hi: Zikr mein sukoon dhoondo

detail.en: Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
detail.hi: Beshak Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko sukoon milta hai.

action.hi: Allah se achha gumaan rakho

detail.en: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.
detail.hi: Allah farmaata hai: main apne bande ke gumaan ke mutaabiq hoon, aur jab woh mujhe yaad karta hai main uske saath hota hoon.

action.hi: Dua ko ibaadat samjho

detail.en: Dua is worship.
detail.hi: Dua hi ibaadat hai.

action.hi: Ummeed ke saath haath uthao

detail.en: Your Lord is too generous to return a servant's raised hands empty.
detail.hi: Tumhara Rab itna kareem hai ki bande ke uthe hue haath khaali nahi lautaata.

action.en: Don't give up on a dua
action.hi: Dua karna mat chhodo

detail.en: Your dua is answered as long as you do not get impatient and say “I prayed and was not answered.”
detail.hi: Dua qubool hoti hai jab tak tum jaldi na karo aur yeh na kaho ki maine dua ki par qubool na hui.

action.en: Call out to Him in your darkest moment
action.hi: Apne sabse andhere waqt mein usse pukaaro

detail.en: So We answered him and saved him from distress. And thus do We save the believers.
detail.hi: Toh humne uski pukaar suni aur use gham se nijaat di. Aur isi tarah hum imaan waalon ko bachaate hain.

action.hi: Apni galtiyan Allah ke saamne maano

detail.en: Those who, when they commit a wrong or wrong themselves, remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins.
detail.hi: Woh log jo koi galti kar baithen ya apne upar zulm kar len, toh Allah ko yaad karte hain aur apne gunaahon ki maafi maangte hain.

action.en: Say: my Lord is with me
action.hi: Kaho: mera Rab mere saath hai

detail.en: Musa said: No! Indeed, my Lord is with me; He will guide me.
detail.hi: Musa ne kaha: hargiz nahi! Beshak mera Rab mere saath hai, woh mujhe raasta dikhayega.

action.en: Never lose hope in Allah's relief
action.hi: Allah ki rehmat se kabhi maayoos na ho

detail.en: Do not despair of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.
detail.hi: Allah ki rehmat se maayoos na ho. Beshak Allah ki rehmat se sirf inkaar karne waale log hi maayoos hote hain.

action.en: Use the dua of Yunus in hardship
action.hi: Mushkil mein Yunus ki dua padho

detail.en: No Muslim ever makes this dua of Dhun-Nun for anything except that Allah answers him.
detail.hi: Jo Musalmaan bhi kisi cheez ke liye Dhun-Nun (Yunus) ki yeh dua karta hai, Allah uski dua qubool karta hai.

action.en: Know that the best are tested most
action.hi: Jaano ki sabse behtar logon ka imtihaan sabse sakht hota hai

detail.en: The people most severely tested are the prophets, then those most like them, and then those most like them.
detail.hi: Sabse sakht imtihaan nabiyon ka hota hai, phir jo unse sabse zyada milte julte hon, phir jo unse milte julte hon.

action.hi: Maangna mat chhodo

detail.en: Your dua is answered as long as you are not hasty and say: I prayed, but I was not answered.
detail.hi: Tumhari dua qubool hoti hai jab tak tum jaldbaazi na karo aur yeh na kaho: maine dua ki par qubool nahi hui.

action.hi: Har dua ko ibaadat samjho

detail.en: Dua is worship.
detail.hi: Dua hi ibaadat hai.

action.en: Know that ease comes with hardship
action.hi: Yaqeen rakho, mushkil ke saath aasaani hai

detail.en: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
detail.hi: Beshak mushkil ke saath aasaani hai. Beshak mushkil ke saath aasaani hai.

action.hi: Sukoon ke liye zikr karo

detail.en: Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
detail.hi: Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko sukoon milta hai.

action.en: Remember you won't be given more than you can carry
action.hi: Yaad rakho, taaqat se zyada bojh nahi diya jaata

detail.en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
detail.hi: Allah kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta.

action.hi: Sabr aur namaaz ka sahaara lo

detail.en: Seek help through patience and prayer; Allah is with the patient.
detail.hi: Sabr aur namaaz se madad lo; Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.

action.en: See the good in every state
action.hi: Har haal mein bhalaai dekho

detail.en: The affair of the believer is amazing: in good times they thank Allah, in hard times they are patient, and both are good for them.
detail.hi: Momin ka maamla ajeeb hai: achhe waqt mein shukr, bure waqt mein sabr, aur dono uske liye behtar hain.

action.en: Know your pain is not wasted
action.hi: Jaano tumhara dard bekaar nahi

detail.en: No worry, grief or hurt befalls a Muslim, even a thorn's prick, except that Allah removes some of their sins by it.
detail.hi: Muslim ko koi fikr, gham ya takleef, yahan tak ki kaanta bhi chubhe, toh Allah uske gunaah mita deta hai.

action.en: Look at those who have less
action.hi: Apne se kam waalon ko dekho

detail.en: Look at those below you, not above you, so you don't belittle Allah's blessings on you.
detail.hi: Apne se neeche waalon ko dekho, upar waalon ko nahi, taaki Allah ki nemat haqeer na lage.

action.en: Trust what is written for you
action.hi: Jo likha hai us par bharosa rakho

detail.en: If the whole world gathered to harm you, they could only harm you with what Allah had already written.
detail.hi: Agar saari duniya tumhe nuqsaan pahunchaane ke liye jama ho jaaye, toh bhi utna hi nuqsaan hoga jitna Allah ne likha hai.

action.en: Seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
action.hi: Subah ke Rab ki panaah lo

detail.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created.
detail.hi: Kaho: main subah ke Rab ki panaah maangta hoon, uski makhlooq ke shar se.

action.hi: Waswase daalne wale se panaah lo

detail.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws.
detail.hi: Kaho: main insaanon ke Rab ki panaah maangta hoon, chhup kar waswasa daalne wale ke shar se.

action.hi: Yaad rakho shaitaan ki chaal kamzor hai

detail.en: Indeed, the plot of Satan is ever weak.
detail.hi: Beshak shaitaan ki chaal kamzor hai.

action.en: Stay close to faith and trust
action.hi: Imaan aur bharose ke qareeb raho

detail.en: He has no authority over those who believe and rely on their Lord.
detail.hi: Usko un par koi zor nahi jo imaan laaye aur apne Rab par bharosa karte hain.

action.en: Hand your safety to the best Guardian
action.hi: Apni hifaazat behtareen Muhaafiz ko saunpo

detail.en: Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most Merciful.
detail.hi: Allah sabse behtar hifaazat karne wala hai, aur sabse zyada reham karne wala.

action.hi: Hifaazat karne wale farishton ko yaad rakho

detail.en: Each person has angels before and behind them, guarding them by Allah's command.
detail.hi: Har insaan ke aage peeche farishte hain jo Allah ke hukm se uski hifaazat karte hain.

action.hi: Ayat-ul-Kursi padho

detail.en: Guarding the heavens and the earth does not tire Him.
detail.hi: Aasmaan aur zameen ki hifaazat use nahi thakaati.

action.hi: Pareshaani mein usko pukaaro

detail.en: Who answers the distressed when they call, and removes the harm?
detail.hi: Kaun hai jo pareshaan ki pukaar sunta hai jab woh pukaare, aur takleef door karta hai?

action.hi: Sone se pehle Ayat-ul-Kursi padho

detail.en: Whoever recites it at bedtime has a guardian from Allah until morning.
detail.hi: Jo sote waqt ise padhe, subah tak Allah ki taraf se muhaafiz rehta hai.

action.en: Recite the three Quls morning and evening
action.hi: Subah shaam teeno Qul padho

detail.en: Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas three times morning and evening; they will suffice you against everything.
detail.hi: Subah shaam teen teen baar Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq aur An-Nas padho, yeh har cheez se kaafi hain.

action.hi: Buri nazar ko halke mein na lo

detail.en: The evil eye is real.
detail.hi: Nazar lagna haq hai.

action.en: Say Bismillah at home and meals
action.hi: Ghar aur khaane par Bismillah kaho

detail.en: When you mention Allah entering your home and eating, Satan says: no place to stay and no dinner.
detail.hi: Jab ghar mein daakhil hote aur khaate waqt Allah ka naam lo, toh shaitaan kehta hai: na rehne ki jagah, na khaana.

action.hi: Allah ki hudood ki hifaazat karo

detail.en: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you.
detail.hi: Allah ka khayaal rakho, woh tumhari hifaazat karega.

action.en: Say the morning and evening protection
action.hi: Subah shaam hifaazat ki dua padho

detail.en: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru… three times: nothing will harm you.
detail.hi: Bismillahil-lazi la yazurru… teen baar: koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayegi.

action.hi: Ghar se nikalne ki dua padho

detail.en: Whoever says it leaving home is told: you are guided, sufficed and protected.
detail.hi: Jo ghar se nikalte waqt yeh padhe, use kaha jaata hai: hidaayat mili, kaafi hua, mehfooz hua.

action.hi: Fajr padho

detail.en: Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah.
detail.hi: Jo Fajr padhta hai woh Allah ki hifaazat mein hai.

action.en: After prayer, go and seek your living
action.hi: Namaaz ke baad rozi talaash karo

detail.en: When the prayer is finished, disperse in the land and seek Allah's bounty.
detail.hi: Jab namaaz ho jaaye toh zameen mein phail jaao aur Allah ka fazl talaash karo.

action.hi: Apne muaahide poore karo

detail.en: O you who believe, fulfil your contracts.
detail.hi: Aye imaan walo, apne aqd poore karo.

action.hi: Har len-den mein insaaf karo

detail.en: Give full measure and weigh with an even balance; that is better and fairer.
detail.hi: Poora naapo aur seedhe taraazu se tolo; yahi behtar aur achha anjaam hai.

action.en: Work as if Allah is watching
action.hi: Aise kaam karo jaise Allah dekh raha hai

detail.en: Do your work: Allah will see it, and so will His Messenger and the believers.
detail.hi: Amal karo; Allah tumhara kaam dekhega, aur uska Rasool aur imaan wale bhi.

action.hi: Har kaam behtareen tareeqe se karo

detail.en: Allah has prescribed excellence in everything.
detail.hi: Allah ne har cheez mein ehsaan (behtareen tareeqa) farz kiya hai.

action.hi: Logon ko waqt par paisa do

detail.en: Give the worker their wage before their sweat dries.
detail.hi: Mazdoor ko uska paseena sookhne se pehle mazdoori de do.

action.hi: Kaarobaar mein imaandaar raho

detail.en: The honest, trustworthy merchant will be with the prophets, the truthful and the martyrs.
detail.hi: Sachcha, amaanatdaar taajir nabiyon, siddiqeen aur shaheedon ke saath hoga.

action.en: Aim to be the giving hand
action.hi: Dene wala haath bano

detail.en: The upper hand is better than the lower hand; the upper hand gives and the lower one asks.
detail.hi: Upar wala haath neeche wale se behtar hai; upar wala dene wala hai aur neeche wala maangne wala.

action.en: Know Allah is enough for you
action.hi: Jaano Allah tumhare liye kaafi hai

detail.en: Whoever relies on Allah, He is enough for them.
detail.hi: Jo Allah par bharosa kare, Allah uske liye kaafi hai.

action.hi: Faisla karo, phir usi par bharosa

detail.en: When you have decided, put your trust in Allah; Allah loves those who rely on Him.
detail.hi: Jab iraada kar lo toh Allah par bharosa karo; Allah bharosa karne walon ko pasand karta hai.

action.hi: Jo likha hai use qubool karo

detail.en: Say: nothing will befall us except what Allah has written for us. He is our Protector.
detail.hi: Kaho: humein wahi pahunchega jo Allah ne humare liye likha hai. Woh humara maalik hai.

action.en: Allow that the thing you dislike may be good
action.hi: Maano ki napasand cheez mein bhi bhalaai ho sakti hai

detail.en: You may dislike something while it is good for you; Allah knows and you do not.
detail.hi: Ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko napasand karo aur woh tumhare liye behtar ho; Allah jaanta hai, tum nahi.

action.hi: Asbaab apnao, phir bharosa

detail.en: Tie your camel, and trust in Allah.
detail.hi: Oont baandho, aur Allah par bharosa karo.

action.hi: Parindon jaisa bharosa

detail.en: If you truly relied on Allah, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds.
detail.hi: Agar tum sachcha bharosa karo toh Allah tumhe parindon ki tarah rizq de.

action.en: Aim to be among those who rely on Him
action.hi: Bharosa karne walon mein shaamil hone ki koshish karo

detail.en: Seventy thousand enter Paradise without reckoning; among their traits, they put their trust in their Lord.
detail.hi: Sattar hazaar log bina hisaab jannat mein jaayenge; unki ek sifat yeh ki woh apne Rab par bharosa karte hain.

action.en: Be mindful of Allah in ease
action.hi: Aasaani mein Allah ko yaad rakho

detail.en: Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him before you. When you ask, ask Allah.
detail.hi: Allah ka khayaal rakho, use apne saamne paaoge. Jab maango toh Allah se maango.

action.en: See your home as a place of rest
action.hi: Ghar ko sukoon ki jagah samjho

detail.en: Allah made your homes a place of rest for you.
detail.hi: Allah ne tumhare gharon ko tumhare liye sukoon ki jagah banaaya.

action.en: Greet with salam when you enter
action.hi: Ghar mein daakhil ho kar salaam karo

detail.en: When you enter houses, greet one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and good.
detail.hi: Jab gharon mein daakhil ho toh ek doosre ko salaam karo, Allah ki taraf se mubaarak aur paak dua.

action.en: Make your home a place of prayer
action.hi: Ghar ko namaaz ki jagah banao

detail.en: Make your houses places of prayer, and establish prayer.
detail.hi: Apne gharon ko namaaz ki jagah banao aur namaaz qaayam karo.

action.hi: Doosron ke ghar ijaazat le kar jaao

detail.en: Do not enter houses other than your own until you have asked permission and greeted the people.
detail.hi: Apne ghar ke ilaawa kisi ghar mein ijaazat aur salaam ke baghair daakhil na ho.

action.hi: Ghar mein Surah Al-Baqarah padho

detail.en: Do not make your houses graves. Satan flees from a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited.
detail.hi: Apne gharon ko qabristaan na banao. Jis ghar mein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaaye, shaitaan wahan se bhaagta hai.

action.en: Say Bismillah as you come in
action.hi: Aate waqt Bismillah kaho

detail.en: When you mention Allah on entering and at meals, Satan finds no place to stay and no dinner.
detail.hi: Daakhil hote aur khaate waqt Allah ka naam lo, toh shaitaan ko na jagah milti hai na khaana.

action.en: Pray your voluntary prayers at home
action.hi: Nafl namaaz ghar mein padho

detail.en: The best prayer of a person is in their home, except the obligatory prayers.
detail.hi: Farz ke ilaawa insaan ki behtareen namaaz uske ghar mein hai.

action.hi: Padosiyon ke saath achha sulook karo

detail.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let them honour their neighbour.
detail.hi: Jo Allah aur aakhirat par imaan rakhta hai, woh apne padosi ki izzat kare.

action.en: Say the travel dua as you set off
action.hi: Nikalte waqt safar ki dua padho

detail.en: Glory to the One who placed this at our service; to our Lord we will return.
detail.hi: Paak hai woh jisne ise humare bas mein kiya; hum apne Rab ki taraf lautne wale hain.

action.en: Travel with eyes open to lessons
action.hi: Seekhne ki nazar se safar karo

detail.en: Travel through the land and see how things ended for those before.
detail.hi: Zameen mein chalo phiro aur dekho pehle walon ka anjaam kya hua.

action.en: Use the ease Allah gives travellers
action.hi: Musaafir ko di gayi aasaani lo

detail.en: There is no blame on you for shortening the prayer when you travel.
detail.hi: Safar mein namaaz qasr karne mein koi gunaah nahi.

action.en: Pack taqwa as well as supplies
action.hi: Saamaan ke saath taqwa bhi rakho

detail.en: Take provision, but the best provision is taqwa.
detail.hi: Zaad-e-raah lo, aur behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai.

action.hi: Safar mein dua karo

detail.en: Three prayers are answered without doubt, including the prayer of the traveller.
detail.hi: Teen duaayein bila shubha qubool hoti hain, unmein musaafir ki dua bhi hai.

action.en: Choose a leader in a group
action.hi: Group mein ek ameer chuno

detail.en: If three set out on a journey, let them appoint one as leader.
detail.hi: Jab teen log safar par niklein toh ek ko ameer bana lein.

action.en: Say Allahu Akbar going up, Subhanallah going down
action.hi: Chadhte waqt Allahu Akbar, utarte waqt Subhanallah

detail.en: The companions said takbir when climbing and tasbih when descending.
detail.hi: Sahaaba chadhaai par takbeer aur utraai par tasbeeh kehte the.

action.en: Return home once your work is done
action.hi: Kaam ho jaaye toh ghar lauto

detail.en: Travel is a piece of hardship; when your need is met, hurry back to your family.
detail.hi: Safar azaab ka ek tukda hai; kaam poora ho toh jaldi ghar lauto.

action.hi: Jaano asal shifa kaun deta hai

detail.en: Ibrahim (AS) said: when I am ill, He is the One who heals me.
detail.hi: Ibrahim (AS) ne kaha: jab main beemaar hota hoon toh wahi mujhe shifa deta hai.

action.hi: Qur'an ko shifa samajh kar padho

detail.en: We send down in the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers.
detail.hi: Hum Qur'an mein woh utaarte hain jo imaan walon ke liye shifa aur rehmat hai.

action.hi: Allah ki banaayi dawaaon ka faayda uthao

detail.en: From the bees comes a drink of varying colours in which there is healing for people.
detail.hi: Shehad ki makkhiyon se rang-birang mashroob nikalta hai jismein logon ke liye shifa hai.

action.en: Call on Him like Ayyub did
action.hi: Ayyub (AS) ki tarah usko pukaaro

detail.en: Ayyub called his Lord, and Allah removed his suffering and restored his family.
detail.hi: Ayyub (AS) ne apne Rab ko pukaara, toh Allah ne unki takleef door ki aur ghar waale lauta diye.

action.hi: Ilaaj karwaao

detail.en: Allah has not sent down a disease without sending down its cure.
detail.hi: Allah ne koi beemaari nahi utaari jiska ilaaj na utaara ho.

action.hi: Bina jhijhak dawa lo

detail.en: Seek treatment, for Allah has made a cure for every disease except old age.
detail.hi: Ilaaj karo, kyunki Allah ne budhaape ke siwa har beemaari ka ilaaj rakha hai.

action.hi: Beemaar ki ayaadat karo

detail.en: Whoever visits a sick person is in the harvest of Paradise until they return.
detail.hi: Jo beemaar ki ayaadat karta hai, lautne tak jannat ke baagh mein rehta hai.

action.hi: Jaano beemaari gunaah mitaati hai

detail.en: No hardship, illness or worry afflicts a Muslim except that Allah expiates sins through it.
detail.hi: Muslim ko jo bhi takleef ya beemaari pahunche, Allah uske zariye gunaah mita deta hai.

action.en: Say Inna lillah and hold on
action.hi: Inna lillah kaho aur thaame raho

detail.en: Give good news to the patient who say, when struck by loss, “To Allah we belong and to Him we return.”
detail.hi: Sabr karne walon ko khushkhabri do, jo museebat par kehte hain: “Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji‘un.”

action.en: Pour out your grief to Allah
action.hi: Apna gham Allah ke saamne rakho

detail.en: Ya‘qub (AS) said: I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah.
detail.hi: Yaqoob (AS) ne kaha: main apna dard aur gham sirf Allah se kehta hoon.

action.en: Remember this life is a passage
action.hi: Yaad rakho yeh zindagi guzargaah hai

detail.en: Every soul will taste death, and you will receive your full reward on the Day of Resurrection.
detail.hi: Har jaan maut ka maza chakhegi, aur poora badla qayaamat ke din milega.

action.hi: Jaano Allah tumhare saath hai

detail.en: “Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.”
detail.hi: “Gham na karo, beshak Allah humare saath hai.”

action.hi: Rona theek hai

detail.en: When his son Ibrahim died, the Prophet ﷺ wept and said: the eyes shed tears and the heart grieves, but we say only what pleases our Lord.
detail.hi: Jab unke bete Ibrahim ka inteqaal hua, Nabi ﷺ roye aur farmaaya: aankhein aansu bahaati hain, dil gham karta hai, par hum wahi kehte hain jo Rab ko pasand ho.

action.en: Hold patience at the first moment
action.hi: Pehle lamhe mein sabr karo

detail.en: True patience is at the first strike of the calamity.
detail.hi: Asal sabr museebat ki pehli chot par hai.

action.hi: Behtar badla maango

detail.en: Say: O Allah, reward me in my loss and replace it with something better.
detail.hi: Kaho: Aye Allah, mujhe meri museebat mein ajr de aur iska behtar badla de.

action.hi: Sabr ke ajr par yaqeen rakho

detail.en: Allah says: My believing servant who is patient when I take a loved one has no reward except Paradise.
detail.hi: Allah farmaata hai: jab main momin bande ka koi pyaara le loon aur woh sabr kare, toh uska badla sirf jannat hai.

action.en: Treat sleep as a gift of rest
action.hi: Neend ko aaraam ka tohfa samjho

detail.en: We made your sleep a means of rest.
detail.hi: Humne tumhari neend ko aaraam ka zariya banaaya.

action.en: Remember Allah holds your soul at night
action.hi: Yaad rakho raat ko rooh Allah ke paas hoti hai

detail.en: Allah takes the souls at death, and those that do not die during their sleep.
detail.hi: Allah maut ke waqt roohein qabz karta hai, aur jo nahi marti unhe neend mein.

action.hi: Raat ko raat rehne do

detail.en: He made the night for you to rest in.
detail.hi: Usne raat banaayi taaki tum usmein aaraam karo.

action.hi: Bistar par Ayat-ul-Kursi padho

detail.en: Allah: no god but Him, the Ever-Living. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him.
detail.hi: Allah, uske siwa koi ma‘bood nahi, hamesha zinda. Na use oongh aati hai na neend.

action.en: Make wudu and lie on your right side
action.hi: Wuzu karo aur daayein karwat leto

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ told al-Bara’ to make wudu before bed and lie on his right side.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne Bara’ (RA) se farmaaya: sone se pehle wuzu karo aur daayein karwat leto.

action.en: Recite the Quls and wipe over yourself
action.hi: Qul padh kar jism par haath phero

detail.en: He would recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas into his hands and wipe over his body, three times.
detail.hi: Aap ﷺ Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq aur An-Nas haathon mein padh kar jism par pherte, teen baar.

action.hi: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar kaho

detail.en: He taught Fatimah and Ali to say them 33, 33 and 34 times at bedtime: better for you than a servant.
detail.hi: Aap ﷺ ne Fatima aur Ali (RA) ko sote waqt 33, 33, 34 baar kehna sikhaaya: yeh khaadim se behtar hai.

action.en: Recite the last two ayat of Al-Baqarah
action.hi: Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do aayatein padho

detail.en: Whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
detail.hi: Jo raat ko Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do aayatein padhe, woh uske liye kaafi hain.

action.hi: Himmat mat haaro

detail.en: Do not weaken and do not grieve; you will be uppermost if you are believers.
detail.hi: Kamzor na pado aur gham na karo; tum hi ghaalib rahoge agar momin ho.

action.hi: Yaad rakho chhoti jamaatein bhi jeeti hain

detail.en: How many a small company has overcome a large company by Allah's permission.
detail.hi: Kitni hi chhoti jamaatein Allah ke hukm se badi jamaaton par ghaalib aayi hain.

action.hi: Logon se nahi, Allah se daro

detail.en: Do not fear them; fear Me, if you are believers.
detail.hi: Unse na daro, mujhse daro, agar tum momin ho.

action.hi: Kaho “mera Rab mere saath hai”

detail.en: With the sea ahead and Pharaoh behind, Musa (AS) said: No! My Lord is with me; He will guide me.
detail.hi: Aage samundar, peeche Firaun, Musa (AS) ne kaha: hargiz nahi! Mera Rab mere saath hai, woh raah dikhaayega.

action.en: Be strong and don't feel helpless
action.hi: Mazboot bano, be-bas mat bano

detail.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah. Seek help from Allah and do not feel helpless.
detail.hi: Taaqatwar momin Allah ko zyada pyaara hai. Allah se madad maango aur himmat na haaro.

action.hi: Taaqat ke saamne sach bolo

detail.en: Among the greatest jihad is a word of truth before a tyrant ruler.
detail.hi: Sabse bada jihaad zaalim haakim ke saamne haq baat kehna hai.

action.hi: Buzdili se panaah maango

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ regularly sought Allah's refuge from cowardice.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ baqaaidagi se buzdili se Allah ki panaah maangte the.

action.hi: Yaad rakho tangi ke saath kushaadgi hai

detail.en: Know that victory comes with patience, relief with distress, and ease with hardship.
detail.hi: Jaan lo, fatah sabr ke saath hai, kushaadgi tangi ke saath, aur aasaani mushkil ke saath.

action.hi: Unhe “uff” tak na kaho

detail.en: Do not say “uff” to them or repel them, but speak to them with noble words.
detail.hi: Unhe “uff” tak na kaho, na jhidko, balki izzat se baat karo.

action.en: Lower your wing in humility and pray for them
action.hi: Aajizi se jhuko aur unke liye dua karo

detail.en: Lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say: My Lord, have mercy on them.
detail.hi: Reham se unke saamne aajizi ka baazu jhukao aur kaho: Rabbir-hamhuma.

action.en: Thank your parents, especially your mother
action.hi: Waalidain, khaas kar maa ka shukr karo

detail.en: His mother carried him in weakness upon weakness. Be grateful to Me and to your parents.
detail.hi: Maa ne use kamzori par kamzori uthaa kar pet mein rakha. Mera aur apne waalidain ka shukr karo.

action.en: Stay kind even when you disagree
action.hi: Ikhtilaaf mein bhi narmi rakho

detail.en: Even if they push you toward wrong, do not obey that, but keep their company in this world with kindness.
detail.hi: Agar woh galat baat par majboor karein toh na maano, par duniya mein unke saath bhalaai se raho.

action.hi: Pehle maa ki izzat

detail.en: Who most deserves my good company? Your mother, your mother, your mother, then your father.
detail.hi: Mere achhe sulook ka sabse zyada haqdaar kaun? Tumhari maa, tumhari maa, tumhari maa, phir tumhare baap.

action.hi: Maa ki khidmat karo

detail.en: Stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet.
detail.hi: Unke saath raho, kyunki jannat unke qadmon ke neeche hai.

action.hi: Unki raza mein Allah ki raza dhoondo

detail.en: The Lord's pleasure is in the parent's pleasure, and His anger in the parent's anger.
detail.hi: Rab ki raza waalid ki raza mein hai, aur Rab ki naaraazgi waalid ki naaraazgi mein.

action.hi: Unki naafarmaani se daro

detail.en: Among the greatest sins: associating partners with Allah and disobeying parents.
detail.hi: Sabse bade gunaahon mein: Allah ke saath shirk aur waalidain ki naafarmaani.

action.en: Protect your family from the Fire
action.hi: Apne ghar waalon ko aag se bachao

detail.en: O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire.
detail.hi: Aye imaan walo, apne aap ko aur apne ghar waalon ko aag se bachao.

action.en: Teach like Luqman taught his son
action.hi: Luqman ki tarah bete ko sikhaao

detail.en: Luqman advised his son gently: worship Allah alone, pray, be patient, and walk humbly.
detail.hi: Luqman ne bete ko pyaar se naseehat ki: sirf Allah ki ibaadat, namaaz, sabr, aur aajizi se chalna.

action.hi: Jo baaqi rahe usmein lagaao

detail.en: Wealth and children are the adornment of this life, but lasting good deeds are better with your Lord.
detail.hi: Maal aur aulaad duniya ki zeenat hain, par baaqi rehne wali nekiyan Rab ke yahan behtar hain.

action.en: Pray for them to be people of prayer
action.hi: Unke namaazi hone ki dua karo

detail.en: My Lord, make me and my descendants keep up the prayer.
detail.hi: Aye mere Rab, mujhe aur meri aulaad ko namaaz qaayam karne wala bana.

action.hi: Yaad rakho tum unke nigehbaan ho

detail.en: Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for their flock.
detail.hi: Tum mein se har ek nigehbaan hai aur har ek se uski ri‘aaya ke baare mein poochha jaayega.

action.hi: Saat saal ki umr se namaaz sikhaao

detail.en: Teach your children to pray when they are seven.
detail.hi: Apne bachchon ko saat saal ki umr mein namaaz sikhaao.

action.hi: Bachchon mein insaaf karo

detail.en: Fear Allah and be just between your children.
detail.hi: Allah se daro aur apni aulaad mein insaaf karo.

action.hi: Unse pyaar jataao

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ kissed his grandson and said: whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne nawaase ko chooma aur farmaaya: jo reham nahi karta us par reham nahi kiya jaata.

action.en: Keep calling on Allah with hope
action.hi: Ummeed ke saath Allah ko pukaarte raho

detail.en: Zakariyya called, “Do not leave me alone,” and Allah answered and gave him Yahya.
detail.hi: Zakariyya (AS) ne pukaara, “Mujhe akela na chhod,” aur Allah ne qubool karke Yahya diye.

action.en: Accept that children are Allah's gift
action.hi: Maano aulaad Allah ka tohfa hai

detail.en: He gives daughters to whom He wills, sons to whom He wills, or both, and leaves whom He wills childless.
detail.hi: Woh jise chahe betiyan deta hai, jise chahe bete, ya dono, aur jise chahe be-aulaad rakhta hai.

action.hi: Yaad rakho Allah ka faisla hairaan kar sakta hai

detail.en: Sarah was given glad news in old age: “Do you wonder at Allah's decree?”
detail.hi: Saara ko budhaape mein khushkhabri mili: “Kya tum Allah ke hukm par ta‘ajjub karti ho?”

action.hi: Allah ki rehmat se kabhi naumeed na ho

detail.en: Do not despair of relief from Allah.
detail.hi: Allah ki rehmat se naumeed na ho.

action.en: Trust that what's meant will come
action.hi: Bharosa rakho jo muqaddar hai woh aayega

detail.en: No soul that Allah has decreed to exist except that it will come into existence.
detail.hi: Jis jaan ka wujood Allah ne likh diya hai, woh zaroor wujood mein aayegi.

action.hi: Bina jaldi kiye dua karte raho

detail.en: Your dua is answered as long as you are not hasty.
detail.hi: Dua qubool hoti hai jab tak jaldi na ki jaaye.

action.hi: Naye bachche ka tahneek karo

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ chewed a date, put it in a newborn's mouth, and made dua for him.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne khajoor chaba kar naye bachche ke munh mein daali aur uske liye dua ki.

action.hi: Aqeeqa se shukr ada karo

detail.en: Every child is held in pledge for its aqiqah, offered on the seventh day.
detail.hi: Har bachcha apne aqeeqe ke saath girvi hai, jo saatve din kiya jaaye.

action.hi: Allah ki rehmat se naumeed na ho

detail.en: My servants who have wronged themselves, do not despair of Allah's mercy; He forgives all sins.
detail.hi: Aye mere bando jinhone apni jaan par zulm kiya, Allah ki rehmat se naumeed na ho; woh saare gunaah maaf karta hai.

action.hi: Foran laut aao

detail.en: When they commit wrong, they remember Allah and ask forgiveness.
detail.hi: Jab woh ghalti kar baithte hain toh Allah ko yaad karte hain aur maafi maangte hain.

action.hi: Gunaah ke baad neki karo

detail.en: Good deeds wipe away bad deeds.
detail.hi: Nekiyan buraaiyon ko mita deti hain.

action.en: Forgive others as you want forgiveness
action.hi: Doosron ko maaf karo jaise khud maafi chahte ho

detail.en: Let them pardon and overlook. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you?
detail.hi: Unhe maaf aur darguzar karna chahiye. Kya tum nahi chahte ki Allah tumhe maaf kare?

action.hi: Jaano har koi ghalti karta hai

detail.en: Every child of Adam makes mistakes, and the best of those who err are those who repent.
detail.hi: Har insaan ghalti karta hai, aur behtareen ghalti karne wale woh hain jo tauba karein.

action.en: Do a good deed after a bad one
action.hi: Buraai ke baad neki karo

detail.en: Follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out.
detail.hi: Buraai ke baad neki karo, woh use mita degi.

action.en: Know His door is open day and night
action.hi: Jaano uska darwaaza din raat khula hai

detail.en: Allah stretches out His hand at night for the one who sinned by day, and by day for the one who sinned at night.
detail.hi: Allah raat ko haath phailaata hai din ke gunaahgaar ke liye, aur din ko raat ke gunaahgaar ke liye.

action.hi: Istighfaar ko roz ki aadat banao

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ sought Allah's forgiveness more than seventy times a day.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ din mein sattar se zyada baar istighfaar karte the.

action.hi: Har kisi se achhi baat karo

detail.en: Speak to people good words.
detail.hi: Logon se achhi baat kaho.

action.hi: Sakht nahi, narm bano

detail.en: Had you been harsh and hard-hearted, they would have scattered from around you.
detail.hi: Agar aap sakht aur sang-dil hote toh log aapke aas paas se chhat jaate.

action.hi: Buraai ko bhalaai se door karo

detail.en: Repel evil with what is better.
detail.hi: Buraai ko behtar tareeqe se door karo.

action.en: Be good to the people around you
action.hi: Aas paas ke logon se bhalaai karo

detail.en: Be good to parents, relatives, orphans, the needy, near and far neighbours and companions.
detail.hi: Waalidain, rishtedaar, yateem, miskeen, qareeb aur door ke padosi aur saathiyon se bhalaai karo.

action.hi: Narmi chuno

detail.en: Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
detail.hi: Allah narm hai aur har maamle mein narmi pasand karta hai.

action.hi: Narmi ko apni zeenat banao

detail.en: Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it.
detail.hi: Narmi jis cheez mein ho use khoobsoorat bana deti hai.

action.hi: Logon se muskura kar milo

detail.en: Your smile at your brother is charity.
detail.hi: Apne bhai ke saamne muskurana sadqa hai.

action.en: Want for others what you want for yourself
action.hi: Doosron ke liye wahi chaaho jo apne liye

detail.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
detail.hi: Tum mein koi momin nahi jab tak apne bhai ke liye wahi na chahe jo apne liye chahta hai.

action.hi: Gussa pee jaao aur maaf karo

detail.en: Those who restrain anger and pardon people; Allah loves those who do good.
detail.hi: Jo gussa pee jaate hain aur logon ko maaf karte hain; Allah nek logon ko pasand karta hai.

action.hi: Gusse mein bhi maaf karo

detail.en: When they are angry, they forgive.
detail.hi: Jab unhe gussa aata hai toh maaf kar dete hain.

action.hi: Uksaaye jaao toh panaah maango

detail.en: If a prompting from Satan stirs you, seek refuge in Allah.
detail.hi: Agar shaitaan ki taraf se koi waswasa aaye toh Allah ki panaah maango.

action.hi: Bewakoofi ki behas se hat jaao

detail.en: Hold to forgiveness, command what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.
detail.hi: Maafi apnao, bhalaai ka hukm do, aur jaahilon se munh pher lo.

action.hi: Gussa mat karo

detail.en: A man asked for advice. The Prophet ﷺ said “Do not get angry,” and repeated it several times.
detail.hi: Ek shakhs ne naseehat maangi. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya “Gussa na karo,” aur kai baar dohraaya.

action.hi: Asal taaqat khud par qaabu hai

detail.en: The strong one controls himself when angry.
detail.hi: Taaqatwar woh hai jo gusse mein khud ko qaabu rakhe.

action.hi: Gusse mein A‘oozu billah kaho

detail.en: Seeking refuge in Allah from Satan would take away the anger.
detail.hi: Shaitaan se Allah ki panaah maangna gussa door kar deta hai.

action.hi: Apni haalat badlo

detail.en: If you are angry while standing, sit down; if it does not leave, lie down.
detail.hi: Khade ho kar gussa aaye toh baith jaao; phir bhi na jaaye toh let jaao.

action.hi: Hasad ki jagah Allah se maango

detail.en: Do not wish for what Allah gave others over you; ask Allah of His bounty.
detail.hi: Doosron ko jo diya gaya uski tamanna na karo; Allah se uska fazl maango.

action.hi: Hasad se panaah maango

detail.en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
detail.hi: Aur hasad karne wale ke shar se jab woh hasad kare.

action.hi: Yaad rakho nemat kaun deta hai

detail.en: Do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty?
detail.hi: Kya woh logon se us par hasad karte hain jo Allah ne unhe apne fazl se diya?

action.en: Pray for a heart free of resentment
action.hi: Keena se paak dil ki dua karo

detail.en: Put no resentment in our hearts toward those who believe.
detail.hi: Humare dilon mein imaan walon ke liye koi keena na rakh.

action.hi: Hasad na karo, bhai bano

detail.en: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not turn your backs; be servants of Allah as brothers.
detail.hi: Ek doosre se hasad na karo, nafrat na karo, munh na phero; Allah ke bande bhai bhai ban jaao.

action.en: Envy only good done for Allah
action.hi: Sirf nek kaamon par rashk karo

detail.en: No envy except in two: someone spending wealth rightly, and someone given wisdom who acts on it and teaches it.
detail.hi: Rashk sirf do par: jo maal sahi jagah kharch kare, aur jise hikmat mili ho aur woh us par amal kare aur sikhaaye.

action.en: Love for others what you love for yourself
action.hi: Doosron ke liye wahi chaaho jo apne liye

detail.en: None of you believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
detail.hi: Koi momin nahi jab tak bhai ke liye wahi na chahe jo apne liye.

action.hi: Pasand aaye toh “BarakAllah” kaho

detail.en: If you see something you like in your brother, pray for blessing for him.
detail.hi: Jab bhai mein koi cheez pasand aaye toh uske liye barkat ki dua karo.

action.hi: Jaano woh qareeb hai

detail.en: When My servants ask about Me, I am near; I answer the call of the caller.
detail.hi: Jab mere bande mere baare mein poochhein, main qareeb hoon, pukaarne wale ki pukaar ka jawaab deta hoon.

action.hi: Sajda karo aur qareeb ho jaao

detail.en: Prostrate and draw near.
detail.hi: Sajda karo aur qareeb ho jaao.

action.en: Follow the Prophet ﷺ to be loved
action.hi: Nabi ﷺ ki pairvi karo, Allah mohabbat karega

detail.en: Say: if you love Allah, follow me, and Allah will love you.
detail.hi: Kaho: agar tum Allah se mohabbat karte ho toh meri pairvi karo, Allah tumse mohabbat karega.

action.en: Remember He is closer than your jugular vein
action.hi: Yaad rakho woh shah-rag se bhi qareeb hai

detail.en: We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
detail.hi: Hum uski shah-rag se bhi zyada qareeb hain.

action.en: Let the Qur'an increase your faith
action.hi: Qur'an se imaan badhao

detail.en: When His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith.
detail.hi: Jab unpar uski aayatein padhi jaati hain toh unka imaan badhta hai.

action.en: Say “my Lord is Allah” and stay firm
action.hi: “Mera Rab Allah hai” kaho aur jame raho

detail.en: Those who say “Our Lord is Allah” and then stand firm, the angels descend on them: do not fear.
detail.hi: Jo kehte hain “humara Rab Allah hai” phir jame rehte hain, un par farishte utarte hain: daro mat.

action.hi: Imtihaan ki ummeed rakho aur saabit raho

detail.en: Do people think they will be left to say “we believe” and not be tested?
detail.hi: Kya log samajhte hain ki “hum imaan laaye” kehne par chhod diye jaayenge aur aazmaaye nahi jaayenge?

action.hi: Apna imaan taaza karte raho

detail.en: O you who believe, believe in Allah and His Messenger.
detail.hi: Aye imaan walo, Allah aur uske Rasool par imaan laao.

action.hi: Sajde mein dua karo

detail.en: The closest a servant is to his Lord is in prostration, so make much dua there.
detail.hi: Banda apne Rab ke sabse qareeb sajde mein hota hai, toh wahan kasrat se dua karo.

action.hi: Nafl amal badhao

detail.en: My servant keeps drawing near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him.
detail.hi: Mera banda nafl amal se mere qareeb hota rehta hai yahan tak ki main usse mohabbat karne lagta hoon.

action.en: Take one step; He comes running
action.hi: Ek qadam badhao, woh daud kar aata hai

detail.en: If he comes to Me walking, I go to him running.
detail.hi: Agar woh mere paas chal kar aaye, main uske paas daud kar jaata hoon.

action.en: Wake in the last third of the night
action.hi: Raat ke aakhri hisse mein jaago

detail.en: Our Lord descends in the last third of the night: who is calling Me, that I may answer?
detail.hi: Humara Rab raat ke aakhri tihaai hisse mein farmaata hai: kaun mujhe pukaarta hai ki main jawaab doon?

action.hi: Imaan laao, phir saabit-qadam raho

detail.en: Say “I believe in Allah,” then be steadfast.
detail.hi: Kaho “main Allah par imaan laaya,” phir us par jame raho.

action.en: Ask Allah to renew your faith
action.hi: Allah se imaan taaza karne ki dua karo

detail.en: Faith wears out in your heart like a garment wears out, so ask Allah to renew it.
detail.hi: Imaan dil mein kapde ki tarah purana ho jaata hai, toh Allah se use naya karne ki dua karo.

action.hi: Imaan ki mithaas chakho

detail.en: Whoever loves Allah and His Messenger most, loves people for Allah, and hates returning to disbelief tastes faith's sweetness.
detail.hi: Jo Allah aur Rasool se sabse zyada mohabbat kare, logon se Allah ke liye mohabbat kare, aur kufr ki taraf lautna na-pasand kare, woh imaan ki mithaas paata hai.

action.hi: Haya apnao

detail.en: Faith has over seventy branches, and modesty is a branch of faith.
detail.hi: Imaan ki sattar se zyada shaakhein hain, aur haya imaan ki ek shaakh hai.

action.hi: Apni namaazon ki hifaazat karo

detail.en: Guard the prayers, especially the middle prayer, and stand before Allah devoutly.
detail.hi: Namaazon ki hifaazat karo, khaas kar beech wali namaaz ki, aur Allah ke saamne adab se khade ho.

action.hi: Namaaz ko din ka saancha banne do

detail.en: Prayer keeps one away from indecency and wrongdoing.
detail.hi: Namaaz behayaai aur buraai se rokti hai.

action.hi: Aajizi se namaaz padho

detail.en: Successful are the believers who are humble in their prayers.
detail.hi: Kaamyaab hain woh momin jo apni namaaz mein aajizi karte hain.

action.en: Lean on prayer when life is heavy
action.hi: Zindagi bhaari ho toh namaaz ka sahaara lo

detail.en: Seek help through patience and prayer.
detail.hi: Sabr aur namaaz se madad lo.

action.hi: Waqt par namaaz padho

detail.en: The deed most loved by Allah is prayer at its proper time.
detail.hi: Allah ko sabse pyaara amal waqt par namaaz hai.

action.hi: Yaad rakho pehla hisaab namaaz ka

detail.en: The first deed a servant will be judged on is the prayer.
detail.hi: Qayaamat mein sabse pehle namaaz ka hisaab hoga.

action.en: Let five prayers wash you clean
action.hi: Paanch namaazein tumhe paak karein

detail.en: Five prayers are like a river at your door you bathe in five times a day.
detail.hi: Paanch namaazein darwaaze par behti nehar ki tarah hain jismein din mein paanch baar nahaao.

action.hi: Aap ﷺ ka tareeqa seekho

detail.en: Pray as you have seen me pray.
detail.hi: Aise namaaz padho jaise mujhe padhte dekha.

action.hi: Shukr karo, aur paao

detail.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
detail.hi: Agar shukr karoge toh main zaroor zyada doonga.

action.hi: Yaad karo aur shukr karo

detail.en: Remember Me; be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
detail.hi: Mujhe yaad karo, mera shukr karo, aur naashukri na karo.

action.hi: Uski nematein gin kar dekho

detail.en: If you tried to count Allah's blessings, you could never number them.
detail.hi: Agar tum Allah ki nematein ginna chaaho toh gin nahi sakoge.

action.en: Aim to be among the few
action.hi: Un thode logon mein shaamil hone ki koshish karo

detail.en: Few of My servants are truly grateful.
detail.hi: Mere bandon mein shukr guzaar thode hi hain.

action.hi: Doosron ki nematon ki tamanna chhodo

detail.en: Do not wish for what Allah has given some of you over others; ask Allah of His bounty.
detail.hi: Us cheez ki tamanna na karo jo Allah ne doosron ko di; Allah se uska fazl maango.

action.en: Don't stare at others' worldly shine
action.hi: Doosron ki duniyavi chamak ko mat taako

detail.en: Do not extend your eyes toward the enjoyment We gave others; your Lord's provision is better and lasting.
detail.hi: Apni nazrein us saamaan ki taraf na phailao jo humne doosron ko diya; tumhare Rab ka rizq behtar aur baaqi rehne wala hai.

action.hi: Duniya ko halka pakdo

detail.en: So that you do not despair over what you missed, nor exult over what you were given.
detail.hi: Taaki jo chhoot jaaye us par gham na karo, aur jo mile us par itraao nahi.

action.en: Thank the people who help you
action.hi: Madad karne walon ka shukriya ada karo

detail.en: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.
detail.hi: Jo logon ka shukriya ada nahi karta, woh Allah ka shukr ada nahi karta.

action.hi: Ibaadat se shukr ada karo

detail.en: Asked why he prayed until his feet swelled, he said: Should I not be a grateful servant?
detail.hi: Poochha gaya ki itni namaaz kyun ki pair sooj gaye, farmaaya: kya main shukr guzaar banda na banoon?

action.en: Praise Allah after eating and drinking
action.hi: Khaane peene ke baad Alhamdulillah kaho

detail.en: Allah is pleased with a servant who eats and praises Him, and drinks and praises Him.
detail.hi: Allah us bande se raazi hota hai jo khaa kar uski taareef kare aur pee kar uski taareef kare.

action.hi: Har haal mein bhalaai dhoondo

detail.en: When good comes to the believer, he is grateful, and that is good for him.
detail.hi: Momin ko bhalaai mile toh shukr karta hai, aur yeh uske liye behtar hai.

action.hi: Dil ki ameeri chaaho

detail.en: Richness is not having many possessions; true richness is richness of the soul.
detail.hi: Ameeri maal ki kasrat ka naam nahi, asal ameeri dil ki ameeri hai.

action.hi: Kaafi par raazi raho

detail.en: Successful is the one who accepts Islam, is given enough, and is made content by Allah.
detail.hi: Kaamyaab hai woh jo Islam laaya, use kaafi rizq mila, aur Allah ne use qanaa‘at di.

action.en: Look at those who have less
action.hi: Kam waalon ko dekho

detail.en: Look at those below you, not above you, so you don't belittle Allah's blessings.
detail.hi: Apne se neeche waalon ko dekho, upar waalon ko nahi.

action.en: Count today's safety, health and food
action.hi: Aaj ki hifaazat, sehat aur khaana gino

detail.en: Whoever wakes safe, healthy and with food for the day, it is as if the whole world was given to them.
detail.hi: Jo subah mehfooz, tandurust aur din bhar ke khaane ke saath uthe, goya use poori duniya mil gayi.

action.en: Ask for the straight path in every prayer
action.hi: Har namaaz mein seedha raasta maango

detail.en: Guide us to the straight path.
detail.hi: Humein seedhe raaste par chala.

action.hi: Koshish karo aur hidaayat ki ummeed rakho

detail.en: Those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
detail.hi: Jo humari raah mein koshish karte hain, hum unhe zaroor apne raaste dikhaate hain.

action.hi: Faisle se pehle mashwara karo

detail.en: Consult them in the matter; then when you decide, rely on Allah.
detail.hi: Maamle mein unse mashwara karo; phir jab iraada kar lo toh Allah par bharosa karo.

action.hi: Hidaayat sirf Allah se maango

detail.en: Whoever Allah guides is the rightly guided.
detail.hi: Jise Allah hidaayat de wahi hidaayat yaafta hai.

action.hi: Bade faisle se pehle istikhaara karo

detail.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught istikhara for all matters, as he taught a surah of the Qur'an.
detail.hi: Nabi ﷺ har maamle ke liye istikhaara aise sikhaate jaise Qur'an ki surah.

action.hi: Shak wali cheez chhodo

detail.en: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
detail.hi: Jo cheez shak mein daale use chhod kar woh lo jo shak mein na daale.

action.hi: Apne zameer ki suno

detail.en: Righteousness is good character; sin is what unsettles your heart and you dislike people knowing.
detail.hi: Neki achha akhlaaq hai; gunaah woh hai jo dil mein khatke aur tum na chaaho ki log jaanein.

action.hi: Bharosemand logon se mashwara karo

detail.en: The one who is consulted is in a position of trust.
detail.hi: Jisse mashwara liya jaaye woh amaanatdaar hai.

action.hi: Maghfirat aur jannat ki taraf daudo

detail.en: Race to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth.
detail.hi: Apne Rab ki maghfirat aur us jannat ki taraf daudo jiski chaudaai aasmaan aur zameen jitni hai.

action.en: Imagine what is hidden for you
action.hi: Socho tumhare liye kya chhupa hai

detail.en: No soul knows what delight is kept hidden for them.
detail.hi: Koi jaan nahi jaanti ki uske liye aankhon ki kya thandak chhupa kar rakhi gayi hai.

action.hi: Apni khwaahishon ko roko

detail.en: Whoever feared standing before his Lord and restrained the soul from desire, Paradise is the refuge.
detail.hi: Jo apne Rab ke saamne khade hone se dara aur nafs ko khwaahish se roka, uska thikaana jannat hai.

action.en: Long for the greeting of peace
action.hi: Salaamati ke istiqbaal ki tamanna rakho

detail.en: Enter it in peace, secure.
detail.hi: Isme salaamati aur aman ke saath daakhil ho jaao.

action.hi: Jaano woh tasavvur se pare hai

detail.en: Allah says: I have prepared for My servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart has imagined.
detail.hi: Allah farmaata hai: maine bandon ke liye woh tayyar kiya jo na aankh ne dekha, na kaan ne suna, na dil mein khayaal aaya.

action.en: Accept that the path has hardships
action.hi: Maano raaste mein mushkilein hain

detail.en: Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire by desires.
detail.hi: Jannat mushkilon se ghiri hai aur jahannum khwaahishon se.

action.hi: Zabaan aur sharmgaah ki hifaazat karo

detail.en: Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and his legs, I guarantee him Paradise.
detail.hi: Jo mujhe zabaan aur sharmgaah ki zamaanat de, main use jannat ki zamaanat deta hoon.

action.en: Spread salam, feed people, pray at night
action.hi: Salaam phailao, khaana khilaao, raat ko namaaz padho

detail.en: Spread salam, feed people, and pray at night while people sleep: you will enter Paradise in peace.
detail.hi: Salaam phailao, khaana khilaao, aur raat ko namaaz padho jab log so rahe hon: salaamati se jannat mein jaaoge.

action.hi: Badlaav apne aap se shuru karo

detail.en: Allah does not change a people's condition until they change what is in themselves.
detail.hi: Allah kisi qaum ki haalat nahi badalta jab tak woh khud apne aap ko na badlein.

action.hi: Apne waqt ki qadr karo

detail.en: By time, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do good, and urge truth and patience.
detail.hi: Zamaane ki qasam, insaan ghaate mein hai, siwaye unke jo imaan laaye, nek amal kiye, aur haq aur sabr ki talqeen ki.

action.hi: Apne nafs par kaam karo

detail.en: Successful is the one who purifies the soul, and lost is the one who buries it.
detail.hi: Kaamyaab hua jisne nafs ko paak kiya, aur naakaam hua jisne use dabaa diya.

action.en: When one task ends, start the next
action.hi: Ek kaam khatam ho toh agla shuru karo

detail.en: When you are free, then stand up in devotion.
detail.hi: Jab faarigh ho toh ibaadat mein lag jaao.

action.hi: Lagaataar raho, chahe thoda

detail.en: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.
detail.hi: Allah ko sabse pyaare amal woh hain jo lagaataar hon, chahe thode hon.

action.hi: Bekaar baaton ko chhodo

detail.en: Part of a person's good Islam is leaving what does not concern them.
detail.hi: Aadmi ke achhe Islam ki nishaani hai ki woh bekaar baatein chhod de.

action.en: Don't waste health and free time
action.hi: Sehat aur fursat zaaya na karo

detail.en: Two blessings many people lose out on: health and free time.
detail.hi: Do nematein jinmein bahut log ghaate mein hain: sehat aur fursat.

action.hi: Miyaana-ravi apnao aur chalte raho

detail.en: The religion is easy; aim for what is right, come close to it, and use the morning, evening and part of the night.
detail.hi: Deen aasaan hai; durust raho, qareeb raho, aur subah, shaam aur raat ke kuch hisse se madad lo.

action.hi: Apne qarz likh kar rakho

detail.en: When you contract a debt for a fixed term, write it down.
detail.hi: Jab muqarrar muddat ke liye qarz lo toh use likh lo.

action.en: Give time to those who owe you
action.hi: Jo tumhara qarzdaar hai use mohlat do

detail.en: If the debtor is in hardship, give time until ease; forgiving it is better for you.
detail.hi: Agar qarzdaar tangi mein ho toh aasaani tak mohlat do; maaf kar dena behtar hai.

action.hi: Amaanatein unke maalikon ko lautaao

detail.en: Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due.
detail.hi: Allah hukm deta hai ki amaanatein unke haqdaaron ko pahunchaao.

action.en: Hold on to taqwa for a way out
action.hi: Raasta nikalne ke liye taqwa thaamo

detail.en: Whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them.
detail.hi: Jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye raasta nikaal deta hai.

action.hi: Qarz ko sanjeedagi se lo

detail.en: A martyr is forgiven everything except debt.
detail.hi: Shaheed ka sab kuch maaf hai siwaye qarz ke.

action.en: Borrow only with the intention to repay
action.hi: Sirf lautaane ki niyyat se qarz lo

detail.en: Whoever takes people's money intending to repay it, Allah will repay it for him.
detail.hi: Jo logon ka maal lautaane ki niyyat se le, Allah uski taraf se ada karwa deta hai.

action.en: Don't delay when you can pay
action.hi: Ada kar sakte ho toh der na karo

detail.en: Delay in paying by one who is able is injustice.
detail.hi: Maaldaar ka qarz ada karne mein taal-matol zulm hai.

action.hi: Achhe tareeqe se lautaao

detail.en: The best of you are those who are best in repaying.
detail.hi: Tum mein behtar woh hai jo qarz achhe tareeqe se ada kare.

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ۝ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ۝ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ۝ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ ۝ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ ۝ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ۝ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa ant. Khalaqtani wa ana ‘abduk, wa ana ‘ala ‘ahdika wa wa‘dika mastata‘t. A‘udhu bika min sharri ma sana‘t. Abu’u laka bi ni‘matika ‘alayya, wa abu’u laka bi dhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, Tu mera Rab hai, Tere siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Tune mujhe paida kiya aur main Tera banda hoon. Main apni taaqat bhar Tere ahad aur waade par qaayam hoon. Maine jo bura kiya uske shar se Teri panaah maangta hoon. Main apne upar Teri nematon ka iqraar karta hoon aur apne gunaah ka bhi iqraar karta hoon, toh mujhe maaf farma de, kyunki Tere siwa koi gunaahon ko maaf nahi karta.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ called this the “master of seeking forgiveness.” He said that whoever says it during the day with firm belief and dies before evening will be among the people of Paradise, and the same for whoever says it at night and dies before morning.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne ise “maafi maangne ka sardaar” kaha. Aap ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo din mein pakke yaqeen ke saath ise padhe aur shaam se pehle uska inteqaal ho jaaye, woh jannat waalon mein se hoga, aur raat ko padhne wale ke liye bhi yahi hai.

note.en: Rabb means the One who nurtures you step by step, not only a master.
note.hi: Rabb ka matlab woh jo qadam qadam paal kar badhaata hai, sirf maalik nahi.

note.en: Same root as ‘ibadah, worship.
Ghafara first meant to cover. Maghfirah is Allah covering your sin and its harm.
note.hi: Ghafara ka asal matlab dhaanpna hai. Maghfirat yaani Allah gunaah aur uske nuqsaan ko dhaanp de.

duas.title: Good in this world and the next
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina ‘adhaban-nar.
duas.english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, humein duniya mein bhi bhalaai de aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalaai de, aur humein jahannum ke azaab se bacha.

story.en: Anas (RA) said this was the dua the Prophet ﷺ made more than any other. In the Qur'an it is praised as the prayer of people who ask Allah for both worlds, not only for this one.
story.hi: Anas (RA) ne bataaya ki Nabi ﷺ sabse zyada yahi dua karte the. Qur'an mein in logon ki taareef hai jo sirf duniya nahi, balki dono jahaan ki bhalaai maangte hain.

note.en: Same root as ihsan (excellence) and husn (beauty).
note.hi: Isi root se ehsaan aur husn bane hain.

note.en: Literally ‘the last one’, from akhir, end.
Same root as taqwa: protecting yourself.
note.hi: Taqwa isi root se hai: apne aap ko bachaana.

duas.title: Increase me in knowledge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ‘ilma.
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mere ilm mein izaafa farma.

story.en: Knowledge is the only thing Allah told the Prophet ﷺ to ask for more of in the Qur'an. The verse came as he hurried to memorise the revelation: be patient, and say “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
story.hi: Qur'an mein ilm hi woh cheez hai jiske izaafe ki dua maangne ka hukm Allah ne Nabi ﷺ ko diya. Yeh aayat tab utri jab Aap ﷺ wahi yaad karne mein jaldi karte the: sabr karo, aur kaho “Rabbi zidni ‘ilma.”

note.en: Ziyadah (increase) comes from this root.
note.hi: Ziyaada isi root se aaya hai.

note.en: Same root as ‘Alim, the All-Knowing, and ‘alam, a sign.
note.hi: Isi root se ‘Aleem (sab jaanne wala) bana hai.

duas.title: Ease my task
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۝ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۝ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۝ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul ‘uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
duas.english: My Lord, expand my chest for me, ease my task for me, and untie the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mera seena khol de, mera kaam mere liye aasaan kar de, aur meri zabaan ki girah khol de taaki log meri baat samajh sakein.

story.en: Musa (AS) said this when Allah commanded him to go to Pharaoh, the most powerful tyrant of his time. He felt the weight of the task and struggled with his speech, so he asked for a calm heart, an easy path and clear words. Allah answered: “You have been granted your request, O Musa.”
story.hi: Jab Allah ne Musa (AS) ko Firaun ke paas jaane ka hukm diya, jo us waqt ka sabse bada zaalim tha, tab unhone yeh dua ki. Kaam bhaari tha aur zabaan mein dikkat thi, isliye unhone sukoon wala dil, aasaan raasta aur saaf baat maangi. Allah ne farmaaya: “Aye Musa, tumhaari maang poori kar di gayi.”

note.en: Sharh, an explanation, comes from the same root: opening something up.
note.hi: Sharah (tashreeh) isi root se: kisi cheez ko khol kar samjhaana.

note.en: Yusr means ease, as in ‘with hardship comes ease’.
note.hi: Yusr yaani aasaani, jaise ‘mushkil ke saath aasaani hai’.

note.en: ‘Aqd, a contract, is also from this root: something tied.
note.hi: ‘Aqd (muaahida, nikah ka aqd) bhi isi root se: baandhi hui cheez.

duas.title: Make the difficult easy
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا ۝ وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja‘altahu sahla, wa anta taj‘alul-hazna idha shi’ta sahla.
duas.english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy when You will.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, koi kaam aasaan nahi siwaye uske jise Tu aasaan bana de, aur Tu jab chahe mushkil ko bhi aasaan bana deta hai.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this short dua as a reminder that no task is easy or hard in itself. Ease is something Allah gives, and He can turn the hardest moment into an easy one.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne yeh chhoti si dua sikhaayi taaki yaad rahe ki koi kaam apne aap aasaan ya mushkil nahi hota. Aasaani Allah deta hai, aur woh sabse mushkil ghadi ko bhi aasaan bana sakta hai.

note.en: Hazn is rugged land. The same letters as huzn, sadness: both feel hard to cross.
note.hi: Hazn yaani pathreeli zameen. Huzn (gham) ke wahi huroof hain: dono paar karna mushkil.

duas.title: Beneficial knowledge and pure provision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا ۝ وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا ۝ وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ilman nafi‘a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbala.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good and pure provision, and deeds that are accepted.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse faayda dene wala ilm, paak aur halaal rizq, aur qubool hone wale amal maangta hoon.

story.en: Umm Salamah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this every morning after the Fajr prayer, as soon as he finished it. He began each day by asking for three things: useful knowledge, pure provision and accepted deeds.
story.hi: Umm Salamah (RA) bataati hain ki Nabi ﷺ har subah Fajr ki namaaz ka salaam pherte hi yeh dua padhte the. Aap ﷺ har din ki shuruaat teen cheezein maang kar karte the: faayda dene wala ilm, paak rizq aur qubool hone wale amal.

note.en: Same root as Ar-Razzaq, the Provider.
Same root as qiblah, the direction you face.
note.hi: Qibla bhi isi root se hai: jis taraf rukh kiya jaaye.

duas.title: The dua of Musa
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
duas.english: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, jo bhi bhalaai Tu mujh par utaare, main uska mohtaaj hoon.

story.en: Musa (AS) fled Egypt alone and reached Madyan tired, hungry and with nothing. He helped two women water their flock, then sat in the shade and made this dua. Soon one of them came back to invite him to her father, and that meeting gave him safety, work and a family.
story.hi: Musa (AS) akele Misr se nikal kar Madyan pahunche, thake hue, bhooke aur khaali haath. Unhone do auraton ki bakriyon ko paani pilaane mein madad ki, phir chhaaon mein baith kar yeh dua ki. Thodi hi der mein unmein se ek unhe apne waalid ke paas bulaane aayi, aur wahin se unhe hifaazat, kaam aur ghar-parivaar mila.

note.en: The word faqir in Urdu and Hindi comes from here.
note.hi: Urdu-Hindi ka ‘faqeer’ yahin se aaya hai.

duas.title: Suffice me with the halal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ ۝ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummakfini bi halalika ‘an haramik, wa aghnini bi fadlika ‘amman siwak.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have forbidden, and by Your grace make me independent of all besides You.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, apne halaal ke zariye mujhe haraam se bacha le, aur apne fazl se mujhe apne siwa sab se be-niyaaz kar de.

story.en: A man who needed money to pay for his freedom came to Ali (RA) for help. Ali taught him this dua, which the Prophet ﷺ had taught him, and said that even if he had a debt as large as a mountain, Allah would pay it off for him.
story.hi: Ek shakhs jise apni aazaadi ke liye paise chukaane the, Ali (RA) ke paas madad maangne aaya. Ali (RA) ne use yeh dua sikhaayi jo Nabi ﷺ ne unhe sikhaayi thi, aur kaha ki agar tum par pahaad jitna qarz bhi ho, Allah use ada karwa dega.

note.en: The everyday word kaafi comes from this root.
note.hi: Roz ka lafz ‘kaafi’ isi root se hai.

note.en: Ghani means rich, free of need. Al-Ghaniyy is one of Allah's names.
note.hi: Ghani yaani maaldaar, be-niyaaz. Al-Ghaniyy Allah ka naam hai.

duas.title: Refuge from worry and grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ ۝ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ ۝ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ ۝ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-‘ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala‘id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by others.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main fikr aur gham se, majboori aur susti se, kanjoosi aur buzdili se, qarz ke bojh aur logon ke dabaav se Teri panaah maangta hoon.

story.en: Anas (RA), who served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years, said he often heard him say this dua. Even the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sought refuge from worry, grief and the weight of debt.
story.hi: Anas (RA), jinhone das saal Nabi ﷺ ki khidmat ki, kehte hain ki woh aksar Aap ﷺ ko yeh dua karte sunte the. Allah ke Rasool ﷺ bhi fikr, gham aur qarz ke bojh se panaah maangte the.

note.en: Scholars note hamm is worry about the future, and hazan is sadness about the past.
note.hi: Ulama kehte hain hamm aane wale kal ki fikr hai, aur hazan beete hue ka gham.

note.en: Mu‘jizah, a miracle, is from this root: something others are helpless to match.
note.hi: Mu‘jiza isi root se: jiska muqaabla koi na kar sake.

note.en: Dayn (debt) and din (religion) share letters: both are things you owe.
note.hi: Dayn (qarz) aur deen ke huroof ek hain: dono mein kuch ada karna hota hai.

duas.title: The dua of Yunus
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
duas.english: There is no god but You, glory be to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.
duas.hinglish: Tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, Tu paak hai. Beshak main hi zulm karne walon mein se tha.

story.en: Yunus (AS) was swallowed by a great fish and found himself in layers of darkness: the night, the sea and the belly of the whale. From there he called out with these words, and Allah saved him. The Prophet ﷺ said that any Muslim who calls on Allah with this dua for anything will be answered.
story.hi: Yunus (AS) ko ek badi machhli ne nigal liya aur woh andheron mein ghir gaye: raat ka andhera, samundar ka andhera aur machhli ke pet ka andhera. Wahan se unhone yeh alfaaz pukaare aur Allah ne unhe bacha liya. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo Muslim kisi bhi cheez ke liye in alfaaz se dua kare, uski dua qubool hoti hai.

note.en: Tasbih comes from this root: declaring Allah far above every flaw.
note.hi: Tasbeeh isi root se: Allah ko har aib se paak maanna.

note.en: Zulm means putting something in the wrong place. Zulmah, darkness, shares the letters.
note.hi: Zulm yaani cheez ko galat jagah rakhna. Zulmat (andhera) ke bhi wahi huroof hain.

duas.title: Allah is sufficient for us
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni‘mal-wakil.
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
duas.hinglish: Allah humare liye kaafi hai, aur woh behtareen kaam banane wala hai.

story.en: Ibn Abbas (RA) said Ibrahim (AS) spoke these words when he was thrown into the fire, and the fire became cool and safe. The Prophet ﷺ and his companions said them when they were told a huge army had gathered against them, and it only increased their faith.
story.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bataaya ki Ibrahim (AS) ne yeh alfaaz tab kahe jab unhe aag mein daala gaya, aur aag thandi aur salaamati wali ho gayi. Nabi ﷺ aur sahaaba ne bhi yahi kaha jab unhe bataaya gaya ki ek bada lashkar unke khilaaf jama hai, aur isse unka imaan aur badh gaya.

note.en: Hisab, calculation, is from the same root.
Tawakkul, trusting Allah, is from this root. Vakeel in Urdu too.
note.hi: Tawakkul isi root se hai. Urdu ka ‘vakeel’ bhi.

duas.title: Morning and evening protection
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ ۝ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma‘a ismihi shay’un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama’, wa huwas-Sami‘ul-‘Alim.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Say three times.)
duas.hinglish: Allah ke naam se, jiske naam ke saath zameen aur aasmaan mein koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahuncha sakti, aur woh sab sunne wala, sab jaanne wala hai. (Teen baar padhein.)

story.en: Uthman (RA) narrated that whoever says this three times in the morning and evening will not be harmed by anything. The narrator, Aban, later had a stroke. When someone looked at him in surprise, he said: the hadith is true, but that day I forgot to say it.
story.hi: Usman (RA) ne riwaayat kiya ki jo subah aur shaam teen baar yeh padhe, use koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayegi. Riwaayat karne wale Abaan ko baad mein faalij ho gaya. Jab kisi ne unhe hairaani se dekha toh unhone kaha: hadees sach hai, bas us din main ise padhna bhool gaya tha.

note.en: Same root as darurah, necessity, and durr, harm.
note.hi: Zarar (nuqsaan) aur zaroorat isi root se hain.

duas.title: Perfect words of Allah
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A‘udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.hinglish: Main Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panaah maangta hoon har us cheez ke shar se jo usne paida ki.

story.en: Khawlah bint Hakim (RA) heard the Prophet ﷺ say that whoever stops at any place and says these words will not be harmed by anything until he leaves it. It is a short shield for a new room, a hotel or a journey's stop.
story.hi: Khawlah bint Hakim (RA) ne Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna ki jo kisi jagah ruke aur yeh alfaaz padhe, use wahan se nikalne tak koi cheez nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayegi. Naye kamre, hotel ya safar ke padaav ke liye yeh ek chhoti si hifaazat hai.

note.en: Ta‘awwudh, saying a‘udhu billah, comes from here.
Kalimah, as in the kalimah of faith.
Tamam in Urdu, meaning all or complete.

duas.title: Dua for travel
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
duas.english: Glory be to the One who has placed this at our service, for we could never have done it ourselves, and to our Lord we will surely return.
duas.hinglish: Paak hai woh zaat jisne is sawaari ko humare bas mein kar diya, warna hum ise qaabu mein nahi kar sakte the, aur beshak hum apne Rab ki taraf lautne wale hain.

story.en: When the Prophet ﷺ mounted his camel to travel, he said Allahu Akbar three times and then recited this. The verse reminds us that every ride is a gift we could not control alone, and every journey points to the last one, back to our Lord.
story.hi: Jab Nabi ﷺ safar ke liye oont par sawaar hote, toh teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte aur phir yeh padhte. Yeh aayat yaad dilaati hai ki har sawaari ek tohfa hai jise hum akele qaabu nahi kar sakte, aur har safar us aakhri safar ki taraf ishaara hai jo apne Rab ki taraf hai.

note.en: Same root as qalb, heart: something that turns.
note.hi: Qalb (dil) isi root se hai: jo palat-ta rehta hai.

duas.title: Dua for healing
