duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ ۝ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي ۝ لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ ۝ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba’s, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa’a illa shifa’uk, shifa’an la yughadiru saqama.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, logon ke Rab, takleef door kar de aur shifa de, Tu hi shifa dene wala hai. Teri shifa ke siwa koi shifa nahi, aisi shifa de jo koi beemaari na chhode.

story.en: Aisha (RA) reported that when someone in the family fell sick, the Prophet ﷺ would gently wipe over them with his right hand and say these words. You can say it for yourself, or with your hand on someone you love.
story.hi: Aisha (RA) bataati hain ki jab ghar mein koi beemaar hota, toh Nabi ﷺ apna daayaan haath pyaar se us par pherte aur yeh alfaaz padhte. Aap ise apne liye padh sakte hain, ya apne kisi pyaare par haath rakh kar.

note.en: Shifa, healing, is from this root.

duas.title: Mercy for my parents
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy on them both as they raised me when I was small.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, in dono par reham farma jaise inhone bachpan mein meri parwarish ki.

story.en: In Surah Al-Isra, Allah places kindness to parents right after worshipping Him alone. He tells us never to say even “uff” to them, to lower the wing of humility out of mercy, and to pray these words for them.
story.hi: Surah Al-Isra mein Allah ne apni ibaadat ke foran baad waalidain ke saath achhe sulook ka hukm diya. Farmaaya ki unhe “uff” tak na kaho, reham se unke saamne aajizi ka baazu jhuka do, aur unke liye yeh dua karo.

note.en: Rahim, the womb, shares this root. Mercy begins where we began.
note.hi: Rehem (maa ki kokh) bhi isi root se hai. Rehmat wahin se shuru hoti hai jahan hum shuru hue.

note.en: Tarbiyah, upbringing, comes from this root.

duas.title: Comfort of our eyes
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a‘yunin waj‘alna lil-muttaqina imama.
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the righteous.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, humein humare jeevan-saathiyon aur aulaad se aankhon ki thandak ata farma, aur humein parhezgaaron ka imaam bana.

story.en: At the end of Surah Al-Furqan, Allah describes the “servants of the Most Merciful”: they walk humbly, pray at night and avoid harm. Among their traits is this dua for families that bring joy to the eyes and lead others to good.
story.hi: Surah Al-Furqan ke aakhir mein Allah “Rahman ke bandon” ka zikr karta hai: jo aajizi se chalte hain, raaton ko ibaadat karte hain aur buraai se bachte hain. Unki ek pehchaan yeh dua hai, aise ghar-parivaar ke liye jo aankhon ki thandak ho aur doosron ko bhalaai ki raah dikhaaye.

note.en: Zawj means one of a pair.
Qarar means settling. Eyes that are at rest, no longer searching.
note.hi: Qaraar yaani thehraav. Aisi aankhein jo sukoon paa lein.

note.en: Umm, mother, shares this root.
note.hi: Umm (maa) bhi isi root se hai.

duas.title: Righteous offspring
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Sami‘ud-du‘a’.
duas.english: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You hear every prayer.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe apni taraf se nek aulaad ata farma. Beshak Tu dua sunne wala hai.

story.en: Zakariyya (AS) was old and his wife had never had children. When he found fruit out of season with young Maryam and she said “It is from Allah,” hope stirred in him and he made this dua on the spot. The angels soon brought him the good news of a son, Yahya.
story.hi: Zakariyya (AS) boodhe ho chuke the aur unki biwi ke koi aulaad nahi thi. Jab unhone Maryam ke paas be-mausam phal dekhe aur Maryam ne kaha “Yeh Allah ki taraf se hai,” toh unke dil mein ummeed jaagi aur unhone wahin yeh dua ki. Jald hi farishton ne unhe bete Yahya ki khushkhabri di.

note.en: Same root as Al-Wahhab, the Bestower.
Du‘a literally means to call out.
note.hi: Dua ka lafzi matlab pukaarna hai.

duas.title: The dua of Adam
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, humne apni jaanon par zulm kiya. Agar Tu humein maaf na kare aur hum par reham na kare toh hum zaroor nuqsaan uthaane walon mein se ho jayenge.

story.en: After Adam and Hawwa ate from the forbidden tree, they did not blame anyone else. They admitted their mistake with these words, and Allah accepted their repentance. It is the first dua of repentance in human history.
story.hi: Jab Adam aur Hawwa ne mana kiye gaye ped se khaaya, toh unhone kisi aur ko ilzaam nahi diya. Unhone in alfaaz ke saath apni ghalti maani aur Allah ne unki tauba qubool ki. Yeh insaani taareekh ki pehli tauba ki dua hai.

note.en: Nafs means self or soul.
Khasarah, loss, as in Urdu khasaara.

duas.title: Keep my heart firm
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi ‘ala dinik.
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.hinglish: Aye dilon ko pherne wale, mere dil ko apne deen par mazboot rakh.

story.en: Anas (RA) said the Prophet ﷺ said this often. The companions asked whether he feared for them even though they believed. He replied that hearts are between two fingers of the Most Merciful, and He turns them as He wills.
story.hi: Anas (RA) kehte hain ki Nabi ﷺ yeh dua bahut karte the. Sahaaba ne poocha ki kya Aap ﷺ humare imaan ke baawajood humare liye darte hain? Aap ﷺ ne farmaaya ki dil Rahman ki do ungliyon ke beech hain, woh jaise chahe unhe pher deta hai.

note.en: Qalb, heart, and Muqallib come from the same root: the heart is called qalb because it keeps turning.
note.hi: Qalb aur Muqallib ek hi root se: dil ko qalb isliye kehte hain ki woh palat-ta rehta hai.

note.en: Thabit, firm, as in the name Thabit.

duas.title: Do not let our hearts deviate
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba‘da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab.
duas.english: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Bestower.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, hidaayat dene ke baad humare dilon ko tedha na kar, aur humein apni taraf se rehmat ata farma. Beshak Tu bahut dene wala hai.

story.en: In Surah Aal-Imran this is the prayer of those “firmly grounded in knowledge.” The more they learn, the more humble they become, so they ask Allah never to let their hearts slip after He has guided them.
story.hi: Surah Aal-Imran mein yeh un logon ki dua hai jo “ilm mein pukhta” hain. Jitna woh seekhte hain, utna aajiz hote jaate hain, isliye Allah se maangte hain ki hidaayat ke baad unke dil kabhi na phislein.

note.en: Hidayah and Al-Hadi come from this root.
note.hi: Hidaayat aur Al-Haadi isi root se.

duas.title: Help me remember and thank You
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a‘inni ‘ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ‘ibadatik.
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best way.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, apne zikr, apne shukr aur apni achhi ibaadat karne mein meri madad farma.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ took Mu'adh (RA) by the hand and said, “O Mu'adh, by Allah, I love you.” Then he advised him never to leave saying this dua at the end of every prayer. It was a gift given with love.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne Muaz (RA) ka haath pakda aur farmaaya, “Aye Muaz, Allah ki qasam, main tumse mohabbat karta hoon.” Phir naseehat ki ki har namaaz ke baad yeh dua kabhi na chhodna. Yeh mohabbat ke saath diya gaya tohfa tha.

note.en: Same root as isti‘anah in Al-Fatihah: wa iyyaka nasta‘in.
note.hi: Al-Fatiha ke ‘iyyaka nasta‘een’ mein yahi root hai.

duas.title: Inspire me to be grateful
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi‘ni an ashkura ni‘matakal-lati an‘amta ‘alayya wa ‘ala walidayya wa an a‘mala salihan tardah.
duas.english: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for the favour You have given me and my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe taufeeq de ki main Teri us nemat ka shukr ada karoon jo Tune mujh par aur mere waalidain par ki, aur aise nek amal karoon jinse Tu raazi ho.

story.en: Sulayman (AS) was marching with his army when he heard an ant warn the others to hide so they would not be crushed. He smiled at her words, and instead of feeling proud of his power, he turned to Allah in gratitude with this dua.
story.hi: Sulaiman (AS) apne lashkar ke saath ja rahe the ki unhone ek cheenti ko doosri cheentiyon se kehte suna ki apne ghar mein chhup jaao, kahin kuchle na jaao. Woh uski baat par muskuraaye, aur apni taaqat par fakhr karne ke bajaaye shukr ke saath Allah se yeh dua ki.

note.en: Rida, contentment, as in raazi.
note.hi: Riza aur raazi isi root se.

duas.title: Asking for Jannah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-jannata wa a‘udhu bika minan-nar.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse jannat maangta hoon aur jahannum se Teri panaah maangta hoon.

story.en: A man told the Prophet ﷺ that he could not make long, beautiful duas like him or Mu'adh. He simply asked for Paradise and refuge from the Fire. The Prophet ﷺ smiled and said that their own duas revolve around the very same thing.
story.hi: Ek shakhs ne Nabi ﷺ se kaha ki main Aap ﷺ ya Muaz ki tarah lambi aur khoobsoorat duaayein nahi kar paata. Main bas jannat maangta hoon aur jahannum se panaah. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki humari duaayein bhi isi ke gird ghoomti hain.

note.en: Su’al, a question, is from this root.
The root means hidden. A garden hidden by its trees; jinn are hidden beings.
note.hi: Root ka matlab chhupa hua. Aisa baagh jo darakhton se dhaka ho; jinn bhi chhupi makhlooq hain.

duas.title: Guidance, piety, chastity, sufficiency
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-‘afafa wal-ghina.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse hidaayat, taqwa, paakdaamni aur be-niyaazi maangta hoon.

story.en: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this. In four words it covers a whole life: knowing the right path, fearing Allah, keeping yourself pure, and needing no one but Him.
story.hi: Ibn Masood (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ yeh dua padhte the. Chaar lafzon mein poori zindagi aa jaati hai: sahi raasta jaanna, Allah se darna, khud ko paak rakhna, aur uske siwa kisi ka mohtaaj na hona.

duas.title: Guide me to the best character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummah-dini li ahsanil-akhlaq, la yahdi li ahsaniha illa ant.
duas.english: O Allah, guide me to the best of character; none guides to the best of it except You.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, mujhe behtareen akhlaaq ki taraf rehnumaai farma. Behtareen akhlaaq ki taraf Tere siwa koi rehnumaai nahi karta.

story.en: This is part of the long dua the Prophet ﷺ said when he stood for the night prayer. Even he, who was described as having the greatest character, asked Allah to guide him to the best of it.
story.hi: Yeh us lambi dua ka hissa hai jo Nabi ﷺ raat ki namaaz shuru karte waqt padhte the. Jinke akhlaaq ko sabse azeem kaha gaya, woh bhi Allah se behtareen akhlaaq ki rehnumaai maangte the.

note.en: Like ihdinas-sirat in Al-Fatihah.
Same root as khalq, creation. Character is how you were shaped inside.
note.hi: Khalq (banaawat) aur akhlaaq ek root se: andar se kaise bane ho.

duas.title: Remove resentment from our hearts
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir lana wa li ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-iman, wa la taj‘al fi qulubina ghillan lil-ladhina amanu, Rabbana innaka Ra’ufur-Rahim.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put no resentment in our hearts toward those who believe. Our Lord, You are Kind and Merciful.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, humein aur humare un bhaiyon ko maaf farma jo imaan mein humse pehle guzar gaye, aur humare dilon mein imaan walon ke liye koi keena na rakh. Aye humare Rab, beshak Tu bahut meharbaan, reham karne wala hai.

story.en: Surah Al-Hashr praises three groups: those who migrated, those who welcomed them in Madinah, and everyone who came after. The later believers are described by this dua: they pray for those before them and ask for hearts free of resentment.
story.hi: Surah Al-Hashr teen giroh ki taareef karti hai: hijrat karne wale, Madina mein unhe gale lagaane wale, aur unke baad aane wale sab log. Baad walon ki pehchaan yeh dua hai: woh pehle walon ke liye dua karte hain aur aise dil maangte hain jismein koi keena na ho.

note.en: Akh means brother, as in akhi.
Sabaq, a lesson, shares this root.

duas.title: When angry
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A‘udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.
duas.hinglish: Main shaitaan mardood se Allah ki panaah maangta hoon.

story.en: Two men were arguing near the Prophet ﷺ, and one became so angry that his face turned red. The Prophet ﷺ said he knew a phrase that would make the anger leave him if he said it, and then he taught these words.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ke paas do aadmi jhagad rahe the, aur ek ko itna gussa aaya ki uska chehra laal ho gaya. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki main ek aisa jumla jaanta hoon jise agar yeh keh de toh iska gussa chala jaaye, aur phir yeh alfaaz sikhaaye.

note.en: Rajm means to stone. At Hajj, pilgrims stone the pillars.
note.hi: Rajm yaani pathar maarna. Hajj mein shaitaan ko kankariyan maarna isi ki yaad hai.

duas.title: Pour patience upon us
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh ‘alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna ‘alal-qawmil-kafirin.
duas.english: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, hum par sabr undel de, humare qadam jama de, aur kaafir qaum ke muqaable mein humari madad farma.

story.en: Talut's small army faced the giant Jalut and his huge forces. Many lost heart, but the believers said, “How often has a small group overcome a large one by Allah's permission,” and prayed these words. Young Dawud (AS) then defeated Jalut.
story.hi: Taloot ka chhota sa lashkar Jaloot aur uski badi fauj ke saamne tha. Bahut se log himmat haar gaye, lekin imaan walon ne kaha, “Kitni hi baar chhoti jamaat Allah ke hukm se badi jamaat par ghaalib aayi hai,” aur yeh dua ki. Phir naujawaan Dawood (AS) ne Jaloot ko haraaya.

note.en: Qadam, foot or step, is used the same way in Urdu.
Nasr, help or victory. Surah An-Nasr.

duas.title: In times of loss
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ ۝ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji‘un. Allahumma’jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha.
duas.english: To Allah we belong and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
duas.hinglish: Beshak hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautne wale hain. Aye Allah, mujhe meri museebat mein ajr de aur iske badle mujhe isse behtar ata farma.

story.en: When her husband Abu Salamah died, Umm Salamah (RA) remembered the Prophet ﷺ teaching this dua. She wondered who could ever be better than Abu Salamah, but she said it anyway. Allah replaced him with the Prophet ﷺ himself, who later married her.
story.hi: Jab unke shauhar Abu Salamah ka inteqaal hua, toh Umm Salamah (RA) ko Nabi ﷺ ki sikhaayi yeh dua yaad aayi. Unhone socha ki Abu Salamah se behtar kaun ho sakta hai, phir bhi unhone yeh dua padhi. Allah ne unhe Nabi ﷺ se behtar badla diya, jinse baad mein unka nikah hua.

note.en: Ruju‘ means to return, as in Urdu ruju karna.
Ajr, reward, as in Urdu.
Same root as khalifah, a successor.
note.hi: Khalifa isi root se: jo peeche aaye.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
duas.english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, Tere naam se main marta hoon aur jeeta hoon.

story.en: Hudhayfah (RA) reported that when the Prophet ﷺ lay down to sleep, he said these words, and on waking he thanked Allah for giving life back after “death.” Each night's sleep is a small rehearsal for our return to Allah.
story.hi: Huzaifa (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ sote waqt yeh alfaaz kehte, aur jaagne par Allah ka shukr ada karte ki usne “maut” ke baad zindagi lautaayi. Har raat ki neend Allah ki taraf laut jaane ki ek chhoti si yaad hai.

note.en: Mawt, death.
Same root as Al-Hayy, the Ever-Living, and hayat, life.
note.hi: Al-Hayy aur hayaat isi root se.

duas.title: A blessed place to settle
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzilin.
duas.english: My Lord, let me settle in a blessed place, for You are the best to accommodate.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe barkat wali jagah utaar, aur Tu sabse behtar utaarne wala hai.

story.en: After the great flood, Allah told Nuh (AS) to say this as he and the believers settled on the ark and looked for a place to land. It is a dua for anyone starting over in a new home or a new city.
story.hi: Bade toofaan ke baad Allah ne Nuh (AS) ko hukm diya ki jab woh aur imaan wale kashti par sawaar hon aur utarne ki jagah talaash karein, toh yeh kahein. Naye ghar ya naye shehar mein nayi shuruaat karne wale har shakhs ke liye yeh dua hai.

note.en: Manzil, a destination, comes from this root.
note.hi: Urdu ka ‘manzil’ isi root se hai.

note.en: Barakah and mubarak come from this root.
note.hi: Barkat aur mubaarak isi root se.

duas.title: Make me steadfast in prayer
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-‘alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du‘a’.
duas.english: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and my descendants too. Our Lord, accept my prayer.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe aur meri aulaad ko namaaz qaayam karne wala bana. Aye humare Rab, meri dua qubool farma.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) left his wife Hajar and baby Isma'il in the empty valley of Makkah by Allah's command. Standing there, he made a series of duas, and this was one of them: that he and his children would always keep up the prayer.
story.hi: Ibrahim (AS) ne Allah ke hukm se apni biwi Hajra aur nanhe Ismail ko Makkah ki sunsaan waadi mein chhoda. Wahan khade ho kar unhone kai duaayein ki, aur yeh unmein se ek thi: ki woh aur unki aulaad hamesha namaaz qaayam rakhein.

note.en: Iqamah, the call to stand for prayer, shares this root.

duas.title: Leaving the house
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۝ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu ‘alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might and no power except with Allah.
duas.hinglish: Allah ke naam se, maine Allah par bharosa kiya. Allah ke siwa na koi taaqat hai na koi quwwat.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that when a person says this while leaving home, it is said to them: “You are guided, you are taken care of, and you are protected,” and the devil turns away from them.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jab koi ghar se nikalte waqt yeh padhta hai, toh us se kaha jaata hai: “Tumhe hidaayat mil gayi, tumhaara kaam ho gaya, aur tum mehfooz ho gaye,” aur shaitaan us se door ho jaata hai.

note.en: Hal, a situation, shares this root.
Same root as Al-Qawiyy, the Most Strong.

duas.title: Do not burden us beyond our strength
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu’akhidhna in nasina aw akhta’na. Rabbana wa la tahmil ‘alayna isran kama hamaltahu ‘alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa‘fu ‘anna, waghfir lana, warhamna. Anta mawlana fansurna ‘alal-qawmil-kafirin.
duas.english: Our Lord, do not take us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with more than we can bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, agar hum bhool jaayein ya ghalti kar baithein toh humari pakad na farma. Aye humare Rab, hum par aisa bojh na daal jaisa humse pehle walon par daala. Aye humare Rab, hum par woh bojh na daal jise uthaane ki humein taaqat nahi. Humein maaf farma, humein bakhsh de, hum par reham farma. Tu hi humara maalik hai, toh kaafir qaum ke muqaable mein humari madad farma.

story.en: These are the closing words of Surah Al-Baqarah, given to the Prophet ﷺ on the night of the Mi‘raj. He said that whoever recites the last two verses of Al-Baqarah at night, they will be enough for him.
story.hi: Yeh Surah Al-Baqarah ke aakhri alfaaz hain, jo Nabi ﷺ ko Mi‘raj ki raat ata kiye gaye. Aap ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo raat ko Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do aayatein padhe, woh uske liye kaafi hain.

note.en: The word taaqat in Urdu comes from here.
Wali, a protecting friend, is from this root. So is maulana.
note.hi: Wali aur maulana isi root se.

duas.title: O Ever-Living, by Your mercy
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith.
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.
duas.hinglish: Aye hamesha zinda rehne wale, aye sab ko qaayam rakhne wale, Teri rehmat ke sahaare main madad maangta hoon.

story.en: Anas (RA) said that whenever something weighed heavily on the Prophet ﷺ, he would say these words. Two of Allah's greatest names, then one plea: Your mercy.
story.hi: Anas (RA) kehte hain ki jab bhi Nabi ﷺ par koi baat bhaari padti, toh Aap ﷺ yeh alfaaz kehte. Allah ke do azeem naam, aur phir ek hi guzaarish: Teri rehmat.

note.en: From qama, to stand. He keeps everything standing.
note.hi: Qaama (khada hona) se. Woh har cheez ko khada rakhta hai.

note.en: Istighathah is a cry for rescue.

duas.title: In times of great distress
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ ۝ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ ۝ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-‘Azimul-Halim. La ilaha illallahu Rabbul-‘arshil-‘azim. La ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-‘arshil-karim.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the noble Throne.
duas.hinglish: Allah ke siwa koi ma‘bood nahi, jo azeem aur burdbaar hai. Allah ke siwa koi ma‘bood nahi, jo azeem arsh ka Rab hai. Allah ke siwa koi ma‘bood nahi, jo aasmaanon ka Rab, zameen ka Rab aur izzat wale arsh ka Rab hai.

story.en: Ibn Abbas (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this at times of great distress. It asks for nothing directly. It simply remembers how great Allah is, and the problem shrinks beside Him.
story.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ sakht pareshaani ke waqt yeh padhte the. Ismein seedha kuch maanga nahi jaata. Bas Allah ki azmat yaad ki jaati hai, aur uske saamne pareshaani chhoti ho jaati hai.

note.en: Same root as ‘azamah, greatness.
Hilm is calm patience that does not rush to punish.
note.hi: Hilm yaani narm sabr jo saza mein jaldi na kare.

duas.title: Do not leave me to myself
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ ۝ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ ۝ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata ‘ayn, wa aslih li sha’ni kullah, la ilaha illa ant.
duas.english: O Allah, it is Your mercy I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Set all my affairs right. There is no god but You.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Teri rehmat ka ummeedwaar hoon, toh mujhe palak jhapakne ke barabar bhi mere apne hawaale na kar. Mere saare kaam durust farma de. Tere siwa koi ma‘bood nahi.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ called these the words of the distressed person. When life feels too heavy to manage, this dua admits the truth: on our own we cannot hold it together, so we ask Allah not to leave us alone for a single moment.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne ise pareshaan shakhs ki dua kaha. Jab zindagi sambhaalna bhaari lage, yeh dua sach maan leti hai: hum akele kuch nahi sambhaal sakte, isliye Allah se maangte hain ki ek pal ke liye bhi humein akela na chhode.

note.en: Same root as tawakkul. You ask Allah never to hand your affairs back to you.
note.hi: Tawakkul wala hi root. Allah se maangna ki mera maamla mujhe waapas na saunpe.

note.en: Islah, reform, as in Urdu.

duas.title: Allah is enough for me
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huw, ‘alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa Rabbul-‘arshil-‘azim.
duas.english: Allah is enough for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is Lord of the mighty Throne.
duas.hinglish: Allah mere liye kaafi hai. Uske siwa koi ma‘bood nahi. Maine usi par bharosa kiya, aur woh azeem arsh ka Rab hai.

story.en: These are the very last words of Surah At-Tawbah. After describing how deeply the Prophet ﷺ cared for his people, Allah tells him: if they turn away, say “Allah is enough for me.” It is the answer for every time people let you down.
story.hi: Yeh Surah At-Tawbah ke bilkul aakhri alfaaz hain. Nabi ﷺ ki apni ummat ke liye fikr bayaan karne ke baad Allah farmaata hai: agar log munh pher lein, toh kaho “Allah mere liye kaafi hai.” Jab bhi log saath chhod dein, yahi jawaab hai.

duas.title: I leave my affair to Allah
duas.arabic: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
duas.transliteration: Wa ufawwidu amri ilallah, innallaha basirun bil-‘ibad.
duas.english: I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah sees His servants.
duas.hinglish: Main apna maamla Allah ke supurd karta hoon. Beshak Allah apne bandon ko dekh raha hai.

story.en: A believing man from Pharaoh's own family hid his faith for years. When he finally spoke up for Musa (AS) in Pharaoh's court, he knew it could cost him his life. He ended his speech with these words, and Allah protected him from their plots.
story.hi: Firaun ke apne khaandaan ka ek imaan wala shakhs saalon tak apna imaan chhupaata raha. Jab aakhir usne Firaun ke darbaar mein Musa (AS) ke haq mein baat ki, toh use pata tha ki jaan ja sakti hai. Usne apni baat in alfaaz par khatam ki, aur Allah ne use unki saazishon se bacha liya.

note.en: Tafwid: handing your matter fully to someone you trust.
note.hi: Tafweez yaani apna maamla poori tarah kisi bharosemand ke supurd karna.

note.en: Basar is sight; basirah is insight.
note.hi: Basar (nazar) aur baseerat isi root se.

duas.title: The dua of Ayyub
duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin.
duas.english: Harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
duas.hinglish: Mujhe takleef pahunchi hai, aur Tu sab reham karne walon se zyada reham karne wala hai.

story.en: Ayyub (AS) lost his wealth, his children and his health, and suffered for years without complaining. When he finally called out, he did not even ask for anything. He only described his pain and Allah's mercy. Allah healed him and returned his family to him, and more.
story.hi: Ayyub (AS) ka maal, aulaad aur sehat sab chala gaya, aur woh saalon bina shikaayat ke takleef sehte rahe. Jab aakhir unhone pukaara, toh kuch maanga bhi nahi. Bas apna dard aur Allah ki rehmat bayaan ki. Allah ne unhe shifa di aur unka ghar-parivaar, balki usse zyada, lauta diya.

words.en: Most Merciful of all who show mercy
words.hi: sab reham karne walon se zyada reham wala

duas.title: When visiting the sick
duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.transliteration: As’alullahal-‘Azim, Rabbal-‘arshil-‘azim, an yashfiyak.
duas.english: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the mighty Throne, to heal you. (Say seven times.)
duas.hinglish: Main azeem Allah se, jo azeem arsh ka Rab hai, sawaal karta hoon ki tumhe shifa de. (Saat baar kahein.)

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever visits a sick person whose time has not yet come and says this seven times beside them, Allah will heal that person.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo kisi aise beemaar ki ayaadat kare jiski maut ka waqt na aaya ho, aur uske paas saat baar yeh kahe, toh Allah use shifa de deta hai.

duas.title: For pain in the body
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ۝ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah (three times). A‘udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (seven times).
duas.english: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear (seven times).
duas.hinglish: Allah ke naam se (teen baar). Main Allah aur uski qudrat ki panaah maangta hoon us takleef ke shar se jo main mehsoos karta hoon aur jiska mujhe dar hai (saat baar).

story.en: Uthman ibn Abi al-‘As (RA) told the Prophet ﷺ about a pain he had felt in his body since accepting Islam. The Prophet ﷺ told him to place his hand on the painful spot and say these words. Uthman said he did, and Allah removed the pain.
story.hi: Usman bin Abil-Aas (RA) ne Nabi ﷺ ko ek dard ke baare mein bataaya jo Islam laane ke waqt se unke jism mein tha. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki dard wali jagah par haath rakho aur yeh alfaaz kaho. Usman (RA) kehte hain ki unhone aisa kiya aur Allah ne dard door kar diya.

note.en: Qudrat in Urdu, and Al-Qadir, the All-Powerful.
note.hi: Qudrat aur Al-Qaadir isi root se.

note.en: Wujud, existence, shares this root: what is found.
note.hi: Wujood isi root se: jo paaya jaaye.

note.en: Hazar, caution.

duas.title: Health in body, hearing and sight
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي ۝ اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي ۝ اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي ۝ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ‘afini fi badani, Allahumma ‘afini fi sam‘i, Allahumma ‘afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant.
duas.english: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. (Three times, morning and evening.)
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, mere jism ko aafiyat de. Aye Allah, meri sunne ki taaqat ko aafiyat de. Aye Allah, meri nazar ko aafiyat de. Tere siwa koi ma‘bood nahi. (Subah aur shaam teen baar.)

story.en: Abdur-Rahman, son of the companion Abu Bakrah, heard his father repeat this three times every morning and evening and asked why. Abu Bakrah said he had heard the Prophet ﷺ say it, and he loved to follow his way.
story.hi: Sahaabi Abu Bakrah (RA) ke bete Abdur-Rahman ne apne waalid ko har subah aur shaam teen baar yeh padhte suna aur wajah poochi. Abu Bakrah ne kaha ki maine Nabi ﷺ ko yeh padhte suna, aur mujhe Aap ﷺ ke tareeqe par chalna pasand hai.

note.en: Badan in Urdu.

duas.title: Pardon and well-being
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’alukal-‘afwa wal-‘afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse duniya aur aakhirat mein maafi aur aafiyat maangta hoon.

story.en: Ibn Umar (RA) said the Prophet ﷺ never left saying this in the morning and evening. He also said that after certainty of faith, no one has been given anything better than well-being.
story.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) kehte hain ki Nabi ﷺ subah aur shaam yeh dua kabhi nahi chhodte the. Aap ﷺ ne yeh bhi farmaaya ki imaan ke yaqeen ke baad kisi ko aafiyat se behtar koi cheez nahi di gayi.

note.en: ‘Afw and ‘afiyah share a root that means to wipe away. One wipes away sin, the other wipes away harm.
note.hi: ‘Afw aur aafiyat ka root mitaana hai. Ek gunaah mitaata hai, doosra takleef.

note.en: From dana, to be near: the nearer, lower life.
note.hi: Dana (qareeb hona) se: qareeb ki, neeche ki zindagi.

duas.title: You love to pardon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka ‘Afuwwun tuhibbul-‘afwa fa‘fu ‘anni.
duas.english: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, Tu bahut maaf karne wala hai aur maaf karna pasand karta hai, toh mujhe maaf farma de.

story.en: Aisha (RA) asked the Prophet ﷺ what she should say if she knew which night was Laylat al-Qadr. Out of all the things she could have asked for, he taught her this one short dua for pardon.
story.hi: Aisha (RA) ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha ki agar mujhe pata chal jaaye ki kaunsi raat Shab-e-Qadr hai, toh main kya kahoon? Itni saari cheezon mein se Aap ﷺ ne unhe maafi ki yeh chhoti si dua sikhaayi.

note.en: ‘Afuww erases the sin completely, so no trace is left.
note.hi: ‘Afuww gunaah ko poori tarah mita deta hai, koi nishaan nahi chhodta.

note.en: Hubb, love, as in mohabbat.
note.hi: Hubb aur mohabbat isi root se.

duas.title: Accept my repentance
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ ۝ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub ‘alayya, innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the One who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe bakhsh de aur meri tauba qubool farma. Beshak Tu tauba qubool karne wala, reham karne wala hai.

story.en: Ibn Umar (RA) said that in a single sitting they would count the Prophet ﷺ saying this a hundred times. If the best of creation asked for forgiveness so often, we need it even more.
story.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) kehte hain ki ek hi majlis mein hum Nabi ﷺ ko sau baar yeh kehte ginte the. Jab sabse behtareen insaan itni baar maafi maangte the, toh humein iski kahin zyada zaroorat hai.

note.en: Tawbah means turning back.

words.en: the One who keeps accepting repentance
words.hi: baar baar tauba qubool karne wala

duas.title: Lying down to sleep
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini ‘adhabaka yawma tab‘athu ‘ibadak.
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise up Your servants. (Three times.)
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, mujhe us din apne azaab se bacha lena jis din Tu apne bandon ko dobaara uthaayega. (Teen baar.)

story.en: Hafsah (RA), wife of the Prophet ﷺ, said that when he wanted to sleep, he placed his right hand under his cheek and said this three times. Lying down each night becomes a reminder of rising on the Last Day.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ki zauja Hafsa (RA) bataati hain ki jab Aap ﷺ sona chahte, toh apna daayaan haath gaal ke neeche rakhte aur teen baar yeh kehte. Har raat letna qayaamat ke din uthne ki yaad ban jaata hai.

note.en: Ba‘th, resurrection; also mab‘uth, one who is sent.

duas.title: In Your name I lie down
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ ۝ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا ۝ وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbi wada‘tu janbi wa bika arfa‘uh. In amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi ‘ibadakas-salihin.
duas.english: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down, and with Your help I rise. If You take my soul, have mercy on it. If You return it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, Tere naam se main apna pehlu rakhta hoon aur Teri madad se hi uthaaunga. Agar Tu meri rooh rok le toh us par reham farma, aur agar lauta de toh uski hifaazat farma jaise Tu apne nek bandon ki hifaazat karta hai.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught that before getting into bed, you should dust it off three times, because you do not know what came onto it after you left, and then say these words.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne sikhaaya ki bistar par jaane se pehle use teen baar jhaad lo, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki tumhare jaane ke baad us par kya aaya, aur phir yeh alfaaz kaho.

note.en: Wudu is a different root. This is wad‘, placing.
note.hi: Yeh wuzu wala lafz nahi. Yeh waza‘ hai, rakhna.

note.en: Rasul, a messenger, is one who is sent from this root.
note.hi: Rasool isi root se: jo bheja jaaye.

duas.title: Last words before sleep
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ ۝ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ ۝ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ ۝ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ ۝ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ ۝ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ ۝ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ ۝ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja’tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk. La malja’a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Amantu bi kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
duas.english: O Allah, I submit myself to You, turn my face to You, entrust my affairs to You and rest my back on You, in hope and in awe of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and Your Prophet whom You sent.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, maine apne aap ko Tere supurd kiya, apna chehra Teri taraf kiya, apna maamla Tujhe saunpa aur apni peeth Tera sahaara le kar tikaayi, Teri ummeed aur Tere dar ke saath. Tujhse bach kar Tere siwa koi panaahgaah nahi. Main Teri utaari hui kitaab aur Tere bheje hue Nabi par imaan laaya.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ told al-Bara’ ibn ‘Azib (RA) to make wudu before bed, lie on his right side and say these as his very last words. If he died that night, he would die on the natural faith. When al-Bara’ repeated it back, he said “Your Messenger,” and the Prophet ﷺ gently corrected him to “Your Prophet.”
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne Bara’ bin Aazib (RA) se farmaaya ki sone se pehle wuzu karo, daayein karwat leto aur aakhri alfaaz yeh kaho. Agar usi raat maut aa gayi toh fitrat par maroge. Jab Bara’ ne dohraaya toh “Tere Rasool” kaha, aur Nabi ﷺ ne pyaar se sahi karwaaya: “Tere Nabi.”

note.en: Islam and salam come from this root: peace through surrender.
note.hi: Islam aur salaam isi root se: supurdagi se sukoon.

note.en: Two rhyming words: raghbah is longing, rahbah is awe.
note.hi: Do hum-aawaaz lafz: raghbat yaani chaahat, rahbat yaani khauf.

duas.title: On waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba‘da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return.
duas.hinglish: Saari taareef Allah ke liye hai jisne humein maut dene ke baad zindagi di, aur usi ki taraf laut kar jaana hai.

story.en: Hudhayfah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this every morning as he woke. The first words of the day are thanks for simply being alive again.
story.hi: Huzaifa (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ har subah jaagte hi yeh kehte the. Din ke pehle alfaaz bas is baat ka shukr hain ki hum phir se zinda hain.

note.en: Muhammad and Ahmad share this root: the praised one.
note.hi: Muhammad aur Ahmad isi root se: jiski taareef ho.

note.en: Nashr means spreading out, as in nashr, publishing.

duas.title: Forgive me and my parents
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir li wa li walidayya wa lil-mu’minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning takes place.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, mujhe, mere waalidain ko aur sab imaan walon ko us din bakhsh dena jis din hisaab qaayam hoga.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) made this dua in old age, near the House he had built in Makkah. After a lifetime of prayers for his children and his city, he ended by asking forgiveness for himself, his parents and every believer.
story.hi: Ibrahim (AS) ne yeh dua budhaape mein ki, Makkah mein us ghar ke paas jo unhone banaaya tha. Apni aulaad aur shehar ke liye zindagi bhar ki duaaon ke baad, unhone apne, apne waalidain aur har imaan wale ke liye maafi maangi.

note.en: Walad, a child, shares this root.
Qiyamah, the Day of standing, is from this root.
note.hi: Qayaamat isi root se: khade hone ka din.

duas.title: The dua of Nuh for family
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir li wa li walidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu’minan wa lil-mu’minina wal-mu’minat.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my home as a believer, and all believing men and women.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe, mere waalidain ko, jo bhi imaan ke saath mere ghar mein aaye usko, aur sab imaan wale mardon aur auraton ko bakhsh de.

story.en: Nuh (AS) called his people to Allah for 950 years, night and day, in public and in private. Few believed. At the end of the surah named after him, he prays for his parents, his home and every believer who would ever come.
story.hi: Nuh (AS) ne 950 saal tak din raat, khule aur chhup kar apni qaum ko Allah ki taraf bulaaya. Bahut kam imaan laaye. Unke naam wali surah ke aakhir mein woh apne waalidain, apne ghar aur aane wale har imaan wale ke liye dua karte hain.

note.en: Bayt, as in Baytullah.
Iman, aman (safety) and amanah (trust) share this root.
note.hi: Imaan, aman aur amaanat ek root se.

duas.title: At the age of forty
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi‘ni an ashkura ni‘matakal-lati an‘amta ‘alayya wa ‘ala walidayya wa an a‘mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimin.
duas.english: My Lord, inspire me to thank You for the blessings You gave me and my parents, to do good that pleases You, and make my children righteous. I turn to You in repentance, and I am one of those who submit.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe taufeeq de ki main Teri un nematon ka shukr karoon jo Tune mujh par aur mere waalidain par ki, aur aise nek kaam karoon jinse Tu raazi ho, aur meri aulaad ko nek bana de. Main Teri taraf tauba karta hoon aur main farmaabardaaron mein se hoon.

story.en: This verse begins by remembering the pain a mother bears in pregnancy and birth. Then it describes a person who reaches full strength at forty and turns back to Allah with this dua, thinking of the parents behind him and the children ahead.
story.hi: Yeh aayat us takleef ko yaad karke shuru hoti hai jo maa hamal aur paidaaish mein uthaati hai. Phir us insaan ka zikr hai jo chaalees saal ki umr mein poori quwwat par pahunch kar Allah ki taraf lautta hai aur yeh dua karta hai, peeche waalidain aur aage aulaad ko yaad karte hue.

duas.title: The dua of Zakariyya
duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-warithin.
duas.english: My Lord, do not leave me alone without an heir, and You are the best of inheritors.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe akela, be-aulaad na chhod, aur Tu sabse behtar waaris hai.

story.en: Zakariyya (AS) was very old, with white hair and a wife who had never conceived. He still called on Allah quietly with this dua. Allah answered: “We responded to him and gave him Yahya, and made his wife able to bear a child.”
story.hi: Zakariyya (AS) bahut boodhe the, safed baal the aur unki biwi ke kabhi aulaad nahi hui thi. Phir bhi unhone chupke se Allah ko is dua ke saath pukaara. Allah ne farmaaya: “Humne uski dua qubool ki, use Yahya ata kiya aur uski biwi ko aulaad ke qaabil bana diya.”

note.en: Fard, a single person, as in Urdu.
Wirasat, inheritance.

duas.title: Grant me a righteous child
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.
duas.english: My Lord, grant me a child from among the righteous.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe nek aulaad ata farma.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) left his homeland after his people tried to burn him, with no children and his whole life behind him. He made this short dua, and Allah gave him the good news of a patient, forbearing son, Isma‘il (AS).
story.hi: Jab Ibrahim (AS) ki qaum ne unhe jalaane ki koshish ki, toh woh apna watan chhod kar nikle, be-aulaad aur poori zindagi peeche chhod kar. Unhone yeh chhoti si dua ki, aur Allah ne unhe ek burdbaar bete, Ismail (AS), ki khushkhabri di.

note.en: Salih, a common name, means righteous.
note.hi: Saaleh naam ka matlab nek hai.

duas.title: The dua of a mother-to-be
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni nadhartu laka ma fi batni muharraran fataqabbal minni, innaka antas-Sami‘ul-‘Alim.
duas.english: My Lord, I have dedicated what is in my womb to You, devoted to Your service, so accept it from me. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, jo mere pet mein hai use maine Tere liye waqf kar diya, toh mujhse qubool farma. Beshak Tu sab sunne wala, sab jaanne wala hai.

story.en: The wife of ‘Imran made this dua while pregnant, giving her unborn child to Allah's service. Allah accepted the child with a beautiful acceptance. She gave birth to Maryam, mother of ‘Isa (AS).
story.hi: Imran ki biwi ne hamal ke dauraan yeh dua ki aur apne aane wale bachche ko Allah ki khidmat ke liye waqf kar diya. Allah ne us bachchi ko behtareen tareeqe se qubool kiya. Unke yahan Maryam paida huin, jo Isa (AS) ki waalida hain.

note.en: Nadhr in Urdu, a vow.
Al-Batin, the Hidden, is one of Allah's names.
note.hi: Al-Baatin Allah ka naam hai, isi root se.

note.en: Hurr means free.

duas.title: Protection for children
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ ۝ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ ۝ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: U‘idhukuma bi kalimatillahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli ‘aynin lammah.
duas.english: I place you both under the protection of Allah's perfect words, from every devil and every harmful creature, and from every evil eye. (For one child: U‘idhuka.)
duas.hinglish: Main tum dono ko Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panaah mein deta hoon, har shaitaan aur har nuqsaan dene wale jaanwar se, aur har buri nazar se. (Ek bachche ke liye: U‘idhuka.)

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ would say this over his grandsons Hasan and Husayn (RA). He told the companions that Ibrahim (AS) used to say the same for his own sons, Isma‘il and Ishaq.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ apne nawaason Hasan aur Husain (RA) par yeh padhte the. Aap ﷺ ne sahaaba ko bataaya ki Ibrahim (AS) bhi apne beton Ismail aur Ishaq ke liye yahi padhte the.

note.en: ‘Ayn is the eye, also a spring of water.

duas.title: For a newly married couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka ‘alayka wa jama‘a baynakuma fi khayr.
duas.english: May Allah bless you, send blessings upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.
duas.hinglish: Allah tumhe barkat de, tum par barkat naazil kare, aur tum dono ko bhalaai mein jod kar rakhe.

story.en: When someone got married, the Prophet ﷺ congratulated them with these words instead of the customs of the time. It is the sunnah way to congratulate a bride and groom, and a beautiful dua for your own marriage.
story.hi: Jab kisi ki shaadi hoti, toh Nabi ﷺ us zamaane ke riwaajon ke bajaaye in alfaaz se mubaarakbaad dete. Dulha-dulhan ko mubaarakbaad dene ka yahi sunnat tareeqa hai, aur apni shaadi ke liye bhi ek khoobsoorat dua.

note.en: Jumu‘ah, the day of gathering, and jama‘ah.
note.hi: Jumu‘a aur jamaat isi root se.

duas.title: Provide for us
duas.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Warzuqna wa anta khayrur-raziqin.
duas.english: Provide for us, for You are the best of providers.
duas.hinglish: Humein rizq de, aur Tu sabse behtar rizq dene wala hai.

story.en: The disciples asked ‘Isa (AS) whether his Lord could send down a table spread with food from the sky. ‘Isa prayed for it, ending with these words. Allah sent it down as a sign.
story.hi: Hawaariyon ne Isa (AS) se poocha ki kya aapka Rab aasmaan se khaane ka dastarkhwaan utaar sakta hai? Isa (AS) ne iske liye dua ki aur in alfaaz par khatam ki. Allah ne use ek nishaani ke taur par utaar diya.

duas.title: Leaving the masjid
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka min fadlik.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse Tera fazl maangta hoon.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught that on entering the masjid we ask Allah for mercy, and on leaving we ask for His bounty. The Qur'an says: when the prayer is over, go out into the land and seek Allah's bounty. Prayer first, then work.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne sikhaaya ki masjid mein daakhil hote waqt Allah se rehmat maango, aur nikalte waqt uska fazl. Qur'an kehta hai: jab namaaz ho jaaye toh zameen mein phail jaao aur Allah ka fazl talaash karo. Pehle namaaz, phir kaam.

note.en: Fadilah, excellence, shares this root.

duas.title: Benefit me with what I learn
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي ۝ وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي ۝ وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahummanfa‘ni bima ‘allamtani, wa ‘allimni ma yanfa‘uni, wa zidni ‘ilma.
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, jo Tune mujhe sikhaaya usse mujhe faayda pahuncha, mujhe woh sikha jo mere liye faaydemand ho, aur mere ilm mein izaafa farma.

story.en: Abu Hurayrah (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ made this dua. It asks for knowledge three ways: to use what you already know, to learn only what is useful, and to keep growing.
story.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ yeh dua karte the. Ismein ilm teen tarah maanga gaya hai: jo pehle se aata hai uska faayda, sirf kaam ki cheez seekhna, aur aage badhte rehna.

note.en: Mu‘allim, a teacher, is from this root.

duas.title: Refuge from useless knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ ۝ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ ۝ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ ۝ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min ‘ilmin la yanfa‘, wa min qalbin la yakhsha‘, wa min nafsin la tashba‘, wa min da‘watin la yustajabu laha.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that is not humble, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a prayer that is not answered.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Teri panaah maangta hoon aise ilm se jo faayda na de, aise dil se jo na dare, aise nafs se jo kabhi na bhare, aur aisi dua se jo qubool na ho.

story.en: Zayd ibn Arqam (RA) said he taught his students exactly what the Prophet ﷺ used to say, and this was among it. Four dangers in one breath: empty learning, a hard heart, endless wanting, and unanswered prayer.
story.hi: Zaid bin Arqam (RA) kehte the ki main tumhe wahi sikhaata hoon jo Nabi ﷺ kehte the, aur yeh unmein se thi. Ek saans mein chaar khatre: bekaar ilm, sakht dil, kabhi na khatam hone waali chaahat, aur qubool na hone waali dua.

note.en: Khushu‘, humility in prayer.
Jawab, an answer, and Al-Mujib come from this root.
note.hi: Jawaab aur Al-Mujeeb isi root se.

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta’khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa‘u ‘indahu illa bi idhnih. Ya‘lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi shay’in min ‘ilmihi illa bima sha’. Wasi‘a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya’uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-‘Aliyyul-‘Azim.
duas.english: Allah: there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Who could intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.hinglish: Allah, uske siwa koi ma‘bood nahi, woh hamesha zinda hai, sab ko qaayam rakhne wala hai. Na use oongh aati hai na neend. Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch hai usi ka hai. Kaun hai jo uski ijaazat ke baghair uske paas sifaarish kare? Woh jaanta hai jo logon ke aage hai aur jo peeche hai, aur log uske ilm mein se kuch bhi nahi ghair sakte siwaye uske jo woh chahe. Uski kursi aasmaanon aur zameen par phaili hui hai, aur unki hifaazat use thakaati nahi. Woh sabse buland, sabse azeem hai.

story.en: Abu Hurayrah (RA) was guarding the charity food when a thief came three nights in a row. On the third night, the thief said: let me go and I will teach you words that will protect you. Recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleep and a guardian from Allah will stay with you until morning. The Prophet ﷺ said: he told you the truth, though he is a liar. That was Shaytan.
story.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) sadqe ke khaane ki nigraani kar rahe the ki teen raat lagaataar ek chor aaya. Teesri raat chor ne kaha: mujhe chhod do, main tumhe aise alfaaz sikhaata hoon jo tumhari hifaazat karenge. Sone se pehle Ayat-ul-Kursi padho, subah tak Allah ki taraf se ek muhaafiz tumhare saath rahega. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya: usne sach kaha, haalaanki woh jhoota hai. Woh shaitaan tha.

note.en: Shafa‘ah, intercession.
The Urdu word kursi, chair, comes from here.
‘Ali, a name, means high.

duas.title: Make this a city of peace
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-‘al hadha baladan aminan warzuq ahlahu minath-thamarat.
duas.english: My Lord, make this a city of safety, and provide its people with fruits.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, is shehar ko aman wala bana de, aur iske rehne walon ko phalon se rizq de.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) made this dua for Makkah when it was an empty, dry valley with no water and no crops. Today it is the safest city on earth and fruit from every land reaches it. You can make it for your own home and city.
story.hi: Ibrahim (AS) ne yeh dua Makkah ke liye tab ki jab woh ek sookhi, khaali waadi thi, na paani na kheti. Aaj woh duniya ka sabse mehfooz shehar hai aur har mulk ke phal wahan pahunchte hain. Aap yeh dua apne ghar aur shehar ke liye bhi kar sakte hain.

note.en: Thamar, fruit or result, as in samar in Urdu.

duas.title: The traveller's dua
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى ۝ وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى ۝ اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ ۝ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ ۝ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas’aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-‘amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin ‘alayna safarana hadha watwi ‘anna bu‘dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl.
duas.english: O Allah, we ask You on this journey for goodness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family we leave behind.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, hum is safar mein Tujhse neki aur taqwa maangte hain, aur aise amal jinse Tu raazi ho. Aye Allah, humare is safar ko aasaan kar de aur iski doori ko samet de. Aye Allah, safar mein Tu humara saathi hai aur peeche ghar waalon ka nigehbaan.

story.en: Ibn Umar (RA) described how the Prophet ﷺ began every journey: mounting his camel, saying Allahu Akbar three times, reciting “Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha,” and then this dua. It trusts Allah with both the road ahead and the family left at home.
story.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bataaya ki Nabi ﷺ har safar kaise shuru karte the: oont par sawaar ho kar teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte, “Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha” padhte, aur phir yeh dua. Ismein aage ka raasta aur peeche ghar waale, dono Allah ke supurd kiye jaate hain.

note.en: Safar, a journey, in Urdu and Hindi.
Sahabah, the companions, is from this root.

duas.title: Boarding a ship or vehicle
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha, inna Rabbi laghafurur-Rahim.
duas.english: In the name of Allah it sails and in His name it anchors. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.
duas.hinglish: Allah ke naam se iska chalna hai aur usi ke naam se iska thehrna. Beshak mera Rab bakhshne wala, reham karne wala hai.

story.en: As the flood began, Nuh (AS) told the believers to board the ark with these words. Waves rose like mountains around them, and the ship carried them safely until it came to rest on Mount Judi.
story.hi: Jab toofaan shuru hua, Nuh (AS) ne imaan walon se kaha ki in alfaaz ke saath kashti mein sawaar ho jaao. Unke chaaron taraf pahaad jaisi lehrein uthin, aur kashti unhe hifaazat se le chali yahan tak ki Judi pahaad par ja thehri.

duas.title: Saying goodbye to a traveller
duas.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Astawdi‘ullaha dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima ‘amalik.
duas.english: I entrust to Allah your faith, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds.
duas.hinglish: Main tumhara deen, tumhari amaanat aur tumhare amal ka anjaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon.

story.en: When the Prophet ﷺ said goodbye to someone setting out on a journey, he would take their hand and not let go until they did, then say these words. A gentle way to send off someone you love.
story.hi: Jab Nabi ﷺ kisi safar par jaane wale ko rukhsat karte, toh uska haath pakadte aur tab tak na chhodte jab tak woh khud na chhod de, phir yeh alfaaz kehte. Kisi pyaare ko rukhsat karne ka ek narm tareeqa.

note.en: Wada‘, farewell, shares this root, as in rukhsat and alvida.
Khatm, the end or seal, as in khatam.

duas.title: Pleased with Allah as my Lord
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا ۝ وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا ۝ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi Muhammadin ﷺ nabiyya.
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet. (Three times, morning and evening.)
duas.hinglish: Main Allah ko apna Rab maan kar, Islam ko apna deen maan kar, aur Muhammad ﷺ ko apna Nabi maan kar raazi hoon. (Subah aur shaam teen baar.)

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever says this three times in the morning and evening, Allah has promised to please them on the Day of Judgement. Say you are pleased with Allah, and He will make sure you are pleased.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo subah aur shaam teen baar yeh kahe, Allah ne waada kiya hai ki qayaamat ke din use raazi kar dega. Tum kaho ki tum Allah se raazi ho, aur woh tumhe raazi kar dega.

note.en: Naba’ means news. A nabi brings news from Allah.
note.hi: Naba’ yaani khabar. Nabi Allah ki khabar laate hain.

duas.title: Make my character beautiful
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi.
duas.english: O Allah, You made my outward form beautiful, so make my character beautiful too.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, Tune meri soorat achhi banaayi, toh meri seerat bhi achhi bana de.

story.en: Ibn Mas‘ud (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this. Some scholars mention it as a dua to say when looking in the mirror: thanking Allah for your face, and asking for a heart to match.
story.hi: Ibn Masood (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ yeh dua karte the. Kuch ulama ise aaina dekhte waqt padhne ki dua bataate hain: apne chehre par Allah ka shukr, aur waisa hi achha dil maangna.

note.en: Khalq and khuluq are the same letters with different vowels: one is your form, one is your character.
note.hi: Khalq aur khuluq ke huroof ek, sirf zabar-pesh alag: ek soorat, ek seerat.

duas.title: Refuge from bad character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaqi wal-a‘mali wal-ahwa’.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from bad character, bad deeds and bad desires.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main bure akhlaaq, bure kaamon aur buri khwaahishon se Teri panaah maangta hoon.

story.en: Qutbah ibn Malik (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ used to say this. It guards the three places where a person goes wrong: how we treat people, what we do, and what we crave.
story.hi: Qutbah bin Maalik (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ yeh dua karte the. Yeh un teen jagahon ki hifaazat karti hai jahan insaan bhatakta hai: logon se sulook, apne kaam, aur apni khwaahishein.

note.en: Munkar, the opposite of ma‘ruf, what is known to be good.
Hawa means desire, and also air: both pull you around.
note.hi: Hawa yaani khwaahish, aur hawa bhi: dono idhar udhar le jaati hain.

duas.title: Truthful in anger and in calm
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۝ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ ۝ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi wash-shahadah, wa as’aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida wal-ghadab, wa as’alukal-qasda fil-faqri wal-ghina.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You to fear You in private and in public. I ask You for words of truth whether I am pleased or angry. And I ask You for moderation in poverty and in wealth.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse akele mein aur sab ke saamne Tera dar maangta hoon. Khushi aur gusse dono haalat mein sach baat kehne ki taufeeq maangta hoon. Aur ghareebi aur ameeri dono mein miyaana-ravi maangta hoon.

story.en: ‘Ammar ibn Yasir (RA) once led a noticeably short prayer. When people questioned it, he said he had made a dua in it that the Prophet ﷺ used to make. This is part of that dua. It asks for balance in the moments that test us most.
story.hi: Ammar bin Yasir (RA) ne ek baar kaafi chhoti namaaz padhaayi. Jab logon ne sawaal kiya, toh unhone kaha ki maine ismein woh dua ki jo Nabi ﷺ kiya karte the. Yeh usi dua ka hissa hai. Ismein un lamhon mein santulan maanga gaya hai jo humein sabse zyada aazmaate hain.

note.en: Ghayb, the unseen, as in ghaib.
Ghazab in Urdu.
Qasd also means purpose, as in maqsad.
note.hi: Qasd ka matlab iraada bhi, jaise maqsad.

duas.title: The dua of Dawud for Allah's love
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ ۝ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ ۝ وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka hubbak, wa hubba man yuhibbuk, wal-‘amalal-ladhi yuballighuni hubbak.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the deeds that will bring me to Your love.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tujhse Teri mohabbat maangta hoon, un logon ki mohabbat jo Tujhse mohabbat karte hain, aur aise amal jo mujhe Teri mohabbat tak pahuncha dein.

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ said this was among the duas of Prophet Dawud (AS). Dawud used to ask Allah to make His love dearer to him than himself, his family and cool water.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki yeh Nabi Dawood (AS) ki duaaon mein se thi. Dawood (AS) Allah se maangte the ki Teri mohabbat mujhe apni jaan, apne ghar waalon aur thande paani se bhi zyada pyaari ho jaaye.

note.en: Tabligh, conveying a message, is from this root.

duas.title: Make faith beloved to us
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا ۝ وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ ۝ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma habbib ilaynal-imana wa zayyinhu fi qulubina, wa karrih ilaynal-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-‘isyan, waj‘alna minar-rashidin.
duas.english: O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts. Make disbelief, sin and disobedience hateful to us, and make us among the rightly guided.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, imaan ko humare liye mehboob bana de aur use humare dilon mein sajaa de. Kufr, gunaah aur naafarmaani ko humare liye napasand bana de, aur humein seedhe raaste walon mein se bana de.

story.en: After the painful day of Uhud, when many companions had been killed, the Prophet ﷺ lined his companions up and praised Allah, then made a long dua. This is part of it. Even in defeat, his first request was for faith that the heart would love.
story.hi: Uhud ke takleef bhare din ke baad, jab bahut se sahaaba shaheed ho chuke the, Nabi ﷺ ne sahaaba ki saffein banwaayin, Allah ki taareef ki aur ek lambi dua ki. Yeh usi ka hissa hai. Haar ke din bhi Aap ﷺ ki pehli maang aisa imaan tha jisse dil mohabbat kare.

note.en: Zinah, adornment, as in zeenat.
Makruh in fiqh comes from this root.
As in al-khulafa’ ar-rashidun.

duas.title: Die among the righteous
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innana sami‘na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu bi Rabbikum fa’amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir ‘anna sayyi’atina wa tawaffana ma‘al-abrar.
duas.english: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: “Believe in your Lord,” and we believed. Our Lord, forgive our sins, wipe away our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous.
duas.hinglish: Aye humare Rab, humne ek pukaarne wale ko imaan ki taraf pukaarte suna ki apne Rab par imaan laao, toh hum imaan le aaye. Aye humare Rab, humare gunaah bakhsh de, humari buraaiyan mita de, aur humein nek logon ke saath maut de.

story.en: Ibn Abbas (RA) stayed one night at the home of his aunt Maymunah, the Prophet's ﷺ wife. He saw the Prophet ﷺ wake in the night, look up at the sky and recite the last verses of Aal-Imran, including this dua, before standing to pray.
story.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ek raat apni khaala Maimoona (RA), Nabi ﷺ ki zauja, ke ghar ruke. Unhone dekha ki Nabi ﷺ raat ko jaage, aasmaan ki taraf dekha aur Aal-Imran ki aakhri aayatein padhin, jinmein yeh dua hai, phir namaaz ke liye khade hue.

note.en: Nida’, a call, as in nida.
Kufr first means to cover. Kaffarah is what covers a sin.
note.hi: Kufr ka asal matlab dhaanpna. Kaffara woh jo gunaah ko dhaanp de.

duas.title: Opening the prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ ۝ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ ۝ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ba‘id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba‘adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini minal-khataya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas. Allahummaghsil khatayaya bil-ma’i wath-thalji wal-barad.
duas.english: O Allah, put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the east and the west. O Allah, cleanse me of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow and hail.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, mere aur mere gunaahon ke beech itni doori kar de jitni Tune mashriq aur maghrib ke beech rakhi hai. Aye Allah, mujhe gunaahon se aise saaf kar de jaise safed kapda mail se saaf kiya jaata hai. Aye Allah, mere gunaahon ko paani, barf aur olon se dho de.

story.en: Abu Hurayrah (RA) noticed the Prophet ﷺ stayed silent for a moment between the opening takbir and the recitation. He asked what he said in that silence, and the Prophet ﷺ taught him this.
story.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne dekha ki Nabi ﷺ takbeer-e-tahreema aur qiraat ke beech thodi der khaamosh rehte hain. Unhone poocha ki us khaamoshi mein Aap kya padhte hain, toh Nabi ﷺ ne unhe yeh sikhaaya.

note.en: Ba‘id, far, as in Urdu.
Khata, a mistake, as in Urdu.
Sharq, sunrise.

duas.title: The dua taught to Abu Bakr
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا ۝ وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ۝ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي ۝ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min ‘indik, warhamni, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.
duas.english: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You. So forgive me with forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, maine apni jaan par bahut zulm kiya, aur Tere siwa koi gunaah maaf nahi karta. Toh apni taraf se mujhe bakhsh de aur mujh par reham farma. Beshak Tu bakhshne wala, reham karne wala hai.

story.en: Abu Bakr (RA), the closest companion of the Prophet ﷺ, asked him for a dua to say in his prayer. Even for Abu Bakr, the best of this ummah after the prophets, the Prophet ﷺ chose words that begin: I have wronged myself greatly.
story.hi: Abu Bakr (RA), jo Nabi ﷺ ke sabse qareebi saathi the, ne namaaz mein padhne ke liye dua maangi. Abu Bakr jaise shakhs ke liye bhi, jo nabiyon ke baad is ummat ke sabse behtar insaan hain, Nabi ﷺ ne aise alfaaz chune jo yahan se shuru hote hain: maine apni jaan par bahut zulm kiya.

note.en: Kasrat, abundance.

duas.title: After the call to prayer
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ ۝ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ ۝ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da‘watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa’imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab‘athhu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa‘adtah.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the highest station and excellence, and raise him to the praised position You promised him.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, is mukammal pukaar aur qaayam hone waali namaaz ke Rab, Muhammad ﷺ ko waseela aur fazeelat ata farma, aur unhe us maqaam-e-mahmood par pahuncha jiska Tune unse waada kiya hai.

story.en: Jabir (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says this after hearing the adhan will be granted my intercession on the Day of Resurrection. A few seconds after every adhan, five times a day.
story.hi: Jabir (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya: jo azaan sun kar yeh dua padhe, qayaamat ke din use meri shafaa‘at naseeb hogi. Din mein paanch baar, har azaan ke baad bas kuch second.

note.en: Da‘wah and du‘a share this root.
note.hi: Dawat aur dua ek root se.

duas.title: Thanks for every blessing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ ۝ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni‘matin aw bi ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
duas.english: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this morning is from You alone, You have no partner. So all praise and thanks are Yours. (In the evening, say “amsa” instead of “asbaha.”)
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, is subah mujh par ya Teri kisi bhi makhlooq par jo bhi nemat hai, woh sirf Teri taraf se hai, Tera koi shareek nahi. Toh saari taareef aur saara shukr Tere hi liye hai. (Shaam ko “asbaha” ki jagah “amsa” kahein.)

story.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever says this in the morning has given thanks for that whole day, and whoever says it in the evening has given thanks for that night.
story.hi: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jo subah yeh kahe usne poore din ka shukr ada kar diya, aur jo shaam ko kahe usne poori raat ka shukr ada kar diya.

note.en: Subh, morning, as in subah.
Shirk comes from this root.

duas.title: Istikhara: asking Allah to choose
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ ۝ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ ۝ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ ۝ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ ۝ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ ۝ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ ۝ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ ۝ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ ۝ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi ‘ilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi qudratik, wa as’aluka min fadlikal-‘azim. Fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta‘lamu wa la a‘lam, wa anta ‘allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta‘lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma‘ashi wa ‘aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih. Wa in kunta ta‘lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma‘ashi wa ‘aqibati amri fasrifhu ‘anni wasrifni ‘anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You to guide my choice through Your knowledge, and to give me ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your great bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not; You know all that is hidden. O Allah, if You know this matter is good for me in my religion, my life and my future, decree it for me, make it easy and bless it for me. And if You know it is bad for me in my religion, my life and my future, turn it away from me and turn me away from it, decree for me what is good wherever it is, and make me content with it.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main Tere ilm ke zariye Tujhse bhalaai ka faisla maangta hoon, Teri qudrat se taaqat maangta hoon, aur Tere azeem fazl ka sawaal karta hoon. Tu qaadir hai, main nahi; Tu jaanta hai, main nahi; aur Tu chhupi baaton ko khoob jaanta hai. Aye Allah, agar Tere ilm mein yeh kaam mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye behtar hai, toh ise mere liye muqarrar kar de, aasaan kar de aur ismein barkat de. Aur agar Tere ilm mein yeh mere deen, meri zindagi aur mere anjaam ke liye bura hai, toh ise mujhse pher de aur mujhe isse pher de, aur jahan bhi bhalaai ho mere liye muqarrar kar de, phir mujhe usse raazi kar de.

story.en: Jabir (RA) said the Prophet ﷺ taught them istikhara for every decision, the way he taught them a surah of the Qur'an. Pray two rak‘ahs outside the obligatory prayer, then say this dua, naming your matter where it says “this matter.” Then go ahead and trust where Allah leads.
story.hi: Jabir (RA) kehte hain ki Nabi ﷺ humein har faisle ke liye istikhara aise sikhaate the jaise Qur'an ki koi surah sikhaate. Farz ke ilaawa do rak‘at namaaz padho, phir yeh dua karo aur “is kaam” ki jagah apna maamla zehan mein rakho. Phir aage badho aur bharosa rakho ki Allah jidhar le jaaye wahi behtar hai.

words.en: I ask You to choose the good
words.hi: Tujhse bhalaai ka faisla maangta hoon

note.en: Istikharah comes from khayr: asking for what is good.
note.hi: Istikhaara khair se bana: bhalaai maangna.

words.en: Knower of all that is hidden
words.hi: chhupi baaton ko khoob jaanne wala

note.en: Aqibat in Urdu.

duas.title: Guide me to the right path
duas.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
duas.transliteration: ‘Asa Rabbi an yahdiyani sawa’as-sabil.
duas.english: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the right way.
duas.hinglish: Ummeed hai mera Rab mujhe seedhe raaste ki taraf rehnumaai karega.

story.en: Musa (AS) fled Egypt alone, with no map, no guide and no plan, heading toward Madyan. As he set off into the desert he said these words. Allah led him safely there, to a new home, a wife, and later, prophethood.
story.hi: Musa (AS) akele Misr se nikle, na naqsha, na rehnuma, na koi mansooba, aur Madyan ki taraf chal pade. Registaan mein qadam rakhte hue unhone yeh alfaaz kahe. Allah ne unhe hifaazat se wahan pahunchaaya, naya ghar diya, biwi di, aur baad mein nubuwwat.

note.en: Sawa’ means even, balanced.
Fi sabilillah: in the way of Allah.
note.hi: Fi sabeelillah: Allah ki raah mein.

duas.title: Inspire me to what is right
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي ۝ وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma alhimni rushdi, wa a‘idhni min sharri nafsi.
duas.english: O Allah, inspire me with sound judgement, and protect me from the evil of my own self.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, mere dil mein sahi raah daal de, aur mujhe mere apne nafs ki buraai se bacha le.
