story.en: When Husayn, the father of ‘Imran ibn Husayn (RA), accepted Islam, he asked the Prophet ﷺ what he should say. The Prophet ﷺ taught him these two short lines. The enemy we most need protection from is often our own self.
story.hi: Jab Imran bin Husain (RA) ke waalid Husain ne Islam qubool kiya, toh unhone Nabi ﷺ se poocha ki main kya kahoon? Nabi ﷺ ne unhe yeh do chhoti lines sikhaayin. Jis dushman se sabse zyada hifaazat chahiye, woh aksar humara apna nafs hota hai.

note.en: Ilham, inspiration.

duas.title: The dua of Asiyah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbibni li ‘indaka baytan fil-jannah, wa najjini min Fir‘awna wa ‘amalih, wa najjini minal-qawmiz-zalimin.
duas.english: My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds, and save me from the wrongdoing people.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mere liye apne paas jannat mein ek ghar bana de, mujhe Firaun aur uske kaamon se bacha le, aur mujhe zaalim qaum se nijaat de.

story.en: Asiyah was the wife of Pharaoh, living in the most powerful palace on earth. She believed in Allah and was tortured for it by her own husband. She asked for a house near Allah before a house in Paradise. Allah made her an example for all believers.
story.hi: Aasiya Firaun ki biwi thin, duniya ke sabse taaqatwar mahal mein rehti thin. Woh Allah par imaan laayin aur iski wajah se unke apne shauhar ne unhe takleefein di. Unhone jannat ke ghar se pehle Allah ke paas ghar maanga. Allah ne unhe saare imaan walon ke liye misaal bana diya.

note.en: Bina’, a building.
She asked for the neighbour before the house.
note.hi: Unhone ghar se pehle padosi maanga.

note.en: Najat, rescue.

duas.title: Make me an heir of Paradise
duas.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Waj‘alni min warathati jannatin-na‘im.
duas.english: And make me one of the heirs of the Garden of Bliss.
duas.hinglish: Aur mujhe nematon wali jannat ke waariso mein se bana de.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) made this as part of a heartfelt series of duas after describing his Lord to his idol-worshipping father and people: the One who created me, guides me, feeds me, heals me when I am sick, and will give me life again.
story.hi: Ibrahim (AS) ne yeh dua duaaon ke ek silsile mein ki, jab unhone apne but-parast baap aur qaum ke saamne apne Rab ka taaruf karaaya: jisne mujhe paida kiya, woh mujhe raah dikhaata hai, khilaata hai, beemaar padoon toh shifa deta hai, aur mujhe dobaara zinda karega.

note.en: Same root as ni‘mah, blessing.

duas.title: Refuge from sin and debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika minal-ma’thami wal-maghram.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
duas.hinglish: Aye Allah, main gunaah aur qarz se Teri panaah maangta hoon.

story.en: Aisha (RA) noticed the Prophet ﷺ often asked for protection from debt in his prayer and asked why. He said that when a person falls into debt, he speaks and lies, and he promises and breaks his promise.
story.hi: Aisha (RA) ne dekha ki Nabi ﷺ namaaz mein aksar qarz se panaah maangte hain, toh wajah poochi. Aap ﷺ ne farmaaya ki jab insaan qarz mein phansta hai toh baat karta hai aur jhooth bolta hai, waada karta hai aur tod deta hai.

note.en: Ithm, sin.
Gharamah means a fine or penalty: a burden you must pay.
note.hi: Ghaarama yaani jurmaana: aisa bojh jo chukaana pade.

duas.title: The dua of Nuh
duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
duas.transliteration: Anni maghlubun fantasir.
duas.english: I am overpowered, so help me.
duas.hinglish: Main haar chuka hoon, ab Tu hi meri madad farma.

story.en: Nuh (AS) called his people to Allah for 950 years, day and night, in public and in private. Only a few believed. The rest mocked him, called him mad and drove him away. When he had given everything he had, he made this short dua. Allah opened the gates of the sky and saved him and the believers in the Ark.
story.hi: Nuh (AS) ne 950 saal tak apni qaum ko din raat, khule aur chhupe, Allah ki taraf bulaaya. Bohot kam log imaan laaye. Baaqi ne mazaak udaaya, unhe deewana kaha aur jhidak diya. Jab unhone apna sab kuch laga diya, tab yeh chhoti si dua ki. Allah ne aasmaan ke darwaaze khol diye aur unhe aur imaan waalon ko kashti mein bacha liya.

words.en: so help me, give me victory

duas.title: The dua of Ibrahim
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana ‘alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilaykal-masir.
duas.english: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, to You we have turned, and to You is the final return.
duas.hinglish: Aye hamare Rab, humne Tujh par bharosa kiya, Teri taraf ruju kiya, aur Teri hi taraf lautna hai.

story.en: Ibrahim (AS) stood alone against his own father and his whole nation, who worshipped idols. He broke their idols, and they threw him into a huge fire, but Allah made it cool and safe for him. He and the few who believed with him separated from their people and put their whole trust in Allah with these words.
story.hi: Ibrahim (AS) apne waalid aur poori qaum ke khilaaf akele khade hue, jo buton ki pooja karti thi. Unhone unke but tod diye, aur qaum ne unhe ek bohot badi aag mein phenk diya, par Allah ne aag ko unke liye thandi aur salaamati waali bana diya. Woh aur unke saath imaan laane waale chand log apni qaum se alag hue aur in alfaaz ke saath poora bharosa Allah par rakh diya.

words.en: we have turned back to You

duas.title: The dua of Lut
duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjini wa ahli mimma ya‘malun.
duas.english: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, mujhe aur mere ghar waalon ko unke kaamon (ki buraai) se bacha le.

story.en: Lut (AS) lived among a people who openly committed shameful sins, and they threatened to drive him out of the town for telling them to stop. Surrounded by evil and worried for his family, he asked Allah to save them. Allah rescued him and his family, except his wife, before the punishment came.
story.hi: Lut (AS) ek aisi qaum mein rehte the jo khule aam sharmnaak gunah karti thi, aur unhe rokne par qaum ne unhe shehar se nikaalne ki dhamki di. Buraai se ghire hue aur apne ghar waalon ki fikr mein, unhone Allah se unhe bachaane ki dua ki. Allah ne azaab aane se pehle unhe aur unke ghar waalon ko, siwaaye unki biwi ke, bacha liya.

duas.title: The dua of Yusuf
duas.arabic: رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimma yad‘unani ilayh, wa illa tasrif ‘anni kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa akun minal-jahilin.
duas.english: My Lord, prison is dearer to me than what they invite me to. If You do not turn their scheming away from me, I may incline towards them and be among the ignorant.
duas.hinglish: Aye mere Rab, jis cheez ki taraf yeh mujhe bula rahi hain usse mujhe qaid zyada pasand hai. Agar Tu inki chaal mujhse na phere, toh main inki taraf jhuk jaaunga aur naadaanon mein se ho jaaunga.

story.en: Yusuf (AS) was a young man far from home, living as a slave in the house of a powerful minister of Egypt. The minister's wife and other women tried to seduce him and threatened him with prison if he refused. He chose prison over sin and asked Allah to protect him. Allah turned their scheming away from him, and years later raised him from prison to be in charge of Egypt's storehouses.
story.hi: Yusuf (AS) ghar se door ek naujawaan the, jo Misr ke ek taaqatwar wazeer ke ghar mein ghulaam ki tarah rehte the. Wazeer ki biwi aur doosri auraton ne unhe gunah ki taraf bulaaya aur inkaar par qaid ki dhamki di. Unhone gunah ke bajaaye qaid ko chuna aur Allah se hifaazat maangi. Allah ne unki chaal unse pher di, aur saalon baad unhe qaid se nikaal kar Misr ke khazaanon ka zimmedaar bana diya.

duas.title: The dua of Ya‘qub
duas.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
duas.transliteration: Innama ashku baththi wa huzni ilallah, wa a‘lamu minallahi ma la ta‘lamun.
duas.english: I only complain of my deep sorrow and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.
duas.hinglish: Main apne gehre dukh aur gham ki shikaayat sirf Allah se karta hoon, aur main Allah ki taraf se woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahi jaante.

story.en: Ya‘qub (AS) lost his beloved son Yusuf, and years later another son was held back in Egypt. He cried until his eyes turned white from grief, and his family warned him he would ruin himself. He did not complain to people. He took his sorrow to Allah alone and told his sons never to lose hope in Allah's mercy. Allah reunited him with his sons and restored his sight.
story.hi: Ya‘qub (AS) ne apne pyaare bete Yusuf ko kho diya, aur saalon baad ek aur beta Misr mein rok liya gaya. Woh itna roye ki gham se unki aankhein safed ho gayin, aur ghar waalon ne kaha ki aap khud ko khatam kar loge. Unhone logon se shikaayat nahi ki. Apna dukh sirf Allah ke saamne rakha aur beton se kaha ki Allah ki rehmat se kabhi maayoos na hona. Allah ne unhe beton se mila diya aur unki aankhon ki roshni lauta di.

words.en: my deep sorrow (that I can't hold in)

jami.name: Al-Jami‘
jami.hi: Dilon aur logon ko jodne wala

khabir.name: Al-Khabir
khabir.hi: Har baat ki khabar rakhne wala

shakur.name: Ash-Shakur
shakur.hi: Thode amal ki bhi qadr karne wala

musawwir.name: Al-Musawwir
musawwir.hi: Maa ke pet mein soorat banaane wala

halim.name: Al-Halim
halim.hi: Burdbaar, jaldi saza na dene wala

rashid.name: Ar-Rashid
rashid.en: The Guide to the right path

short.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad.
short.hi: Aye Allah, Muhammad ﷺ par rehmat naazil farma.
short.ref: Short form of the salawat · Qur'an 33:56

saw.en: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him.
saw.hi: Allah un par rehmat aur salaamati naazil farmaaye.
saw.ref: Said whenever the Prophet ﷺ is mentioned

aal.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
aal.tl: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammad.
aal.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
aal.hi: Aye Allah, Muhammad ﷺ aur unki aal par rehmat naazil farma.
aal.ref: From the salawat in Sahih al-Bukhari 3370

ibrahimi.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ۝ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۝ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
ibrahimi.tl: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta ‘ala Ibrahima wa ‘ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
ibrahimi.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
ibrahimi.hi: Aye Allah, Muhammad ﷺ aur unki aal par rehmat naazil farma, jaise Tune Ibrahim (AS) aur unki aal par rehmat naazil farmaayi. Beshak Tu taareef wala, buzurgi wala hai.

azwaj.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ
azwaj.tl: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatih.
azwaj.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, his wives and his descendants.
azwaj.hi: Aye Allah, Muhammad ﷺ, unki azwaaj aur unki aulaad par rehmat naazil farma.
azwaj.ref: From the salawat in Sahih al-Bukhari 3369

barik.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
barik.tl: Allahumma barik ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammad.
barik.en: O Allah, send Your barakah upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
barik.hi: Aye Allah, Muhammad ﷺ aur unki aal par barkat naazil farma.
barik.ref: From the salawat in Sahih al-Bukhari 3370

abd.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
abd.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger.
abd.hi: Aye Allah, apne bande aur apne Rasool Muhammad ﷺ par rehmat naazil farma.
abd.ref: From the salawat in Sahih al-Bukhari 6358

ummi.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
ummi.tl: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa ‘ala ali Muhammad.
ummi.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and the family of Muhammad.
ummi.hi: Aye Allah, Nabi-e-Ummi Muhammad ﷺ aur unki aal par rehmat naazil farma.
ummi.ref: From the salawat in Sunan Abi Dawud 981

sallim.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
sallim.tl: Allahumma salli wa sallim ‘ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
sallim.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
sallim.hi: Aye Allah, humare Nabi Muhammad ﷺ par rehmat aur salaamati naazil farma.
sallim.ref: Following Qur'an 33:56: send blessings and peace

opening.en: Fadalah ibn ‘Ubayd (RA) said the Prophet ﷺ heard a man make dua in his prayer without praising Allah or sending blessings on the Prophet. He said, “This man was hasty.” Then he taught: when you make dua, begin by praising your Lord, then send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ, then ask for whatever you wish. He also said that whoever sends one blessing on him, Allah sends ten blessings on that person.
opening.hi: Fazaalah bin Ubaid (RA) bataate hain ki Nabi ﷺ ne ek shakhs ko namaaz mein Allah ki taareef aur Nabi par darood ke baghair dua karte suna. Aap ﷺ ne farmaaya, “Isne jaldi ki.” Phir sikhaaya: jab dua karo toh pehle apne Rab ki taareef karo, phir Nabi ﷺ par darood bhejo, phir jo chaaho maango. Aap ﷺ ne yeh bhi farmaaya ki jo mujh par ek baar darood bhejta hai, Allah us par das rehmatein bhejta hai.

comfort.en: What you're feeling is heavy, and it's okay to bring all of it to Allah. He knows every thought that keeps you awake, and He is closer to you than you think.
comfort.hi: Jo aap mehsoos kar rahe ho woh bhaari hai, aur yeh sab Allah ke saamne rakh dena bilkul theek hai. Woh aapki har soch jaanta hai, aur aapke bohot qareeb hai.

verse.en: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
verse.hi: Suno, Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko sukoon milta hai.

label.hi: aage kya hoga, is baat se darr

comfort.en: Fear makes the future look darker than it is. The One who holds tomorrow is already there, and nothing reaches you except what He has written with wisdom and care.
comfort.hi: Darr aane waale kal ko asal se zyada andhera dikhata hai. Jo kal ka maalik hai woh pehle se wahan hai, aur aap tak wahi pahunchta hai jo usne hikmat aur pyaar se likha hai.

verse.en: Say: Nothing will ever befall us except what Allah has written for us. He is our Protector.
verse.hi: Keh do: humein sirf wahi pahunchega jo Allah ne hamare liye likh diya hai. Wahi hamara Maula hai.

comfort.en: Your tears are not weakness. Ya'qub (AS) cried until his eyes turned white, and he said, "I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah." Tell Him everything; He is listening.
comfort.hi: Aapke aansu kamzori nahi hain. Yaqub (AS) itna roye ki aankhein safed ho gayin, aur unhone kaha: "Main apna dukh aur gham sirf Allah se kehta hoon." Sab kuch usse keh do, woh sun raha hai.

verse.en: He said: I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah.
verse.hi: Unhone kaha: main apne dukh aur gham ki shikayat sirf Allah se karta hoon.

comfort.en: When it feels like no one sees you, Allah sees you completely, and He has not left you. Yunus (AS) was alone in the darkness of the sea, and Allah heard his whisper.
comfort.hi: Jab lage ki koi aapko nahi dekhta, Allah aapko poori tarah dekh raha hai, aur usne aapko chhoda nahi. Yunus (AS) samandar ke andhere mein akele the, aur Allah ne unki dheemi pukaar sun li.

verse.en: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased.
verse.hi: Tumhare Rab ne tumhe na chhoda hai, na woh tumse naraaz hai.

comfort.en: You've been carrying a lot for a long time. Allah promised He never places on a soul more than it can bear, so even this, you can carry with His help. Rest your heart with Him.
comfort.hi: Aap bohot der se bohot kuch utha rahe ho. Allah ka waada hai ki woh kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta, toh yeh bhi aap uski madad se utha loge. Apna dil usi ke paas rakh do.

verse.en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
verse.hi: Allah kisi jaan par uski taaqat se zyada bojh nahi daalta.

comfort.en: This hardship is not the end of your story. Allah said it twice so your heart would believe it: with hardship comes ease. A way out is coming from where you don't expect.
comfort.hi: Yeh mushkil aapki kahaani ka ant nahi hai. Allah ne do baar kaha taaki dil yaqeen kare: mushkil ke saath aasaani hai. Raasta wahan se niklega jahan se aapne socha bhi nahi.

verse.en: So surely with hardship comes ease. Surely with hardship comes ease.
verse.hi: Beshak mushkil ke saath aasaani hai. Beshak mushkil ke saath aasaani hai.

label.hi: kisi apne ko kho dene ka gham

comfort.en: Missing someone is love that has nowhere to go. We belong to Allah and to Him we return, and those who are patient in loss are given good news. Your dua can still reach the one you miss.
comfort.hi: Kisi ko yaad karna woh pyaar hai jise ab jaane ki jagah nahi milti. Hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautna hai, aur sabr karne waalon ko khushkhabri hai. Aapki dua ab bhi unhe pahunch sakti hai.

verse.en: Those who, when disaster strikes them, say: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
verse.hi: Jab un par musibat aati hai toh kehte hain: hum Allah ke hain aur usi ki taraf lautne waale hain.

label.hi: dil toota hua ya dhoka khaaya

comfort.en: Being hurt by someone you trusted leaves a deep wound. Allah saw every moment of it, and He is the One who mends broken hearts. What He takes away, He replaces with something better.
comfort.hi: Jis par bharosa kiya ho usse chot milna gehra zakhm deta hai. Allah ne har lamha dekha, aur wahi toote dil jodta hai. Jo woh le leta hai, uski jagah behtar deta hai.

verse.en: Perhaps you dislike a thing and it is good for you. Allah knows, and you do not know.
verse.hi: Ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko na pasand karo aur wahi tumhare liye behtar ho. Allah jaanta hai, tum nahi jaante.

label.en: guilty about a sin or mistake
label.hi: kisi gunah ya galti par sharminda

comfort.en: The pain you feel about your sin is itself a sign of iman. Allah loves to forgive, and He is happier with your return than you can imagine. No sin is bigger than His mercy.
comfort.hi: Gunah par jo dard aap mehsoos kar rahe ho, woh khud imaan ki nishani hai. Allah ko maaf karna pasand hai, aur aapke lautne par woh aapki soch se zyada khush hota hai. Koi gunah uski rehmat se bada nahi.

verse.en: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.
verse.hi: Allah ki rehmat se maayoos na ho. Beshak Allah saare gunah maaf kar deta hai.

comfort.en: The fact that you miss closeness to Allah means your heart is still alive. Take one small step towards Him, and He comes to you faster. He never closed the door.
comfort.hi: Allah ki qurbat ki kami mehsoos hona batata hai ki aapka dil abhi zinda hai. Uski taraf ek chhota qadam uthao, woh aapki taraf usse tez aata hai. Usne darwaza kabhi band nahi kiya.

verse.en: Remember Me; I will remember you.
verse.hi: Tum mujhe yaad karo, main tumhe yaad karunga.

label.hi: lagta hai dua qubool nahi ho rahi

comfort.en: Allah has heard every single dua you made. He answers in one of three ways: He gives it, He keeps it for you in the akhirah, or He turns away a harm you never saw. Keep asking; your dua is never wasted.
comfort.hi: Allah ne aapki har ek dua suni hai. Woh teen tarah jawaab deta hai: ya woh de deta hai, ya aakhirat ke liye rakh leta hai, ya koi aisi musibat taal deta hai jo aapne dekhi bhi nahi. Maangte raho, dua kabhi zaaya nahi hoti.

verse.en: I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.
verse.hi: Main qareeb hoon. Jab pukaarne wala mujhe pukaarta hai toh main jawaab deta hoon.

comfort.en: Anger is a fire, and it's human to feel it. The Prophet ﷺ said the truly strong one is the one who controls himself when angry. Pause, seek refuge in Allah, and let Him cool your heart.
comfort.hi: Gussa ek aag hai, aur insaan ko aata hai. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya asli taaqatwar woh hai jo gusse mein khud ko sambhaal le. Ruk jao, Allah ki panaah maango, aur use apne dil ko thanda karne do.

verse.en: Those who restrain anger and pardon people. Allah loves those who do good.
verse.hi: Jo gussa pee jaate hain aur logon ko maaf kar dete hain. Allah neki karne waalon se mohabbat karta hai.

comfort.en: Comparing steals the joy of what Allah already gave you. Your rizq, your timing and your test are written just for you. Ask Him for good, and pray for them too; the angels say "and for you the same".
comfort.hi: Muqabla us khushi ko chura leta hai jo Allah ne pehle se di hai. Aapka rizq, aapka waqt aur aapka imtihaan sirf aapke liye likha hai. Usse bhalaai maango, aur unke liye bhi dua karo; farishte kehte hain "aur tumhare liye bhi".

verse.en: Do not wish for that by which Allah has favoured some of you over others. Ask Allah of His bounty.
verse.hi: Us cheez ki tamanna na karo jisme Allah ne kuch ko kuch par fazilat di hai. Allah se uska fazl maango.

comfort.en: Not knowing which way to go is a heavy place to stand. Hand the choice to the One who knows the unseen: pray istikhara, then take the step, trusting that He will make good easy for you.
comfort.hi: Kaunsa raasta chunein, yeh na jaanna mushkil hai. Faisla us Zaat ko saunp do jo ghaib jaanta hai: istikhara padho, phir qadam uthao, is bharose ke saath ki woh bhalaai aasaan kar dega.

verse.en: When you have decided, then put your trust in Allah. Allah loves those who trust Him.
verse.hi: Jab tum iraada kar lo toh Allah par bharosa karo. Allah bharosa karne waalon se mohabbat karta hai.

comfort.en: Money worries can take over every thought. Remember that your rizq was written before you were born, and no one can take what is yours. Do your part, and leave the outcome to the Best of Providers.
comfort.hi: Paison ki fikr har soch par chha jaati hai. Yaad rakho aapka rizq aapke paida hone se pehle likh diya gaya, aur jo aapka hai woh koi nahi le sakta. Apni koshish karo, nateeja sabse behtar Rozi dene waale par chhod do.

verse.en: Whoever fears Allah, He will make a way out for him, and provide for him from where he does not expect.
verse.hi: Jo Allah se darta hai, Allah uske liye raasta nikaal deta hai aur use wahan se rizq deta hai jahan se usne socha bhi na ho.

comfort.en: Debt can feel like a weight on your chest day and night. The Prophet ﷺ taught a dua for exactly this, and promised that Allah would settle a debt even as big as a mountain for the one who says it.
comfort.hi: Qarz din raat seene par bojh jaisa lagta hai. Nabi ﷺ ne isi ke liye dua sikhaayi, aur farmaaya ki jo yeh padhe Allah uska pahaad jitna qarz bhi ada karwa dega.

verse.en: There is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision.
verse.hi: Zameen par koi chalne wala nahi jiska rizq Allah ke zimme na ho.

comfort.en: Your worth is not your job title, and your provision is not in any one door. Allah opens doors no one can close. Make the effort, and ask Him to make it easy and full of barakah.
comfort.hi: Aapki qeemat aapki naukri se nahi hai, aur aapka rizq kisi ek darwaze mein band nahi. Allah woh darwaze kholta hai jinhe koi band nahi kar sakta. Koshish karo, aur usse aasaani aur barakat maango.

verse.en: Whatever mercy Allah opens to people, none can withhold it.
verse.hi: Allah logon ke liye jo rehmat khol de, use koi rok nahi sakta.

comfort.en: You've done what you can; now let Allah carry the rest. Musa (AS) asked for an open chest, an easy task and clear words, and Allah gave him all three. Ask Him the same.
comfort.hi: Aapne jo ho saka kiya, ab baaqi Allah par chhod do. Musa (AS) ne khula seena, aasaan kaam aur saaf zabaan maangi, aur Allah ne teeno de diye. Aap bhi wahi maango.

verse.en: My Lord, expand for me my chest, and ease for me my task.
verse.hi: Aye mere Rab, mera seena khol de aur mera kaam aasaan kar de.

comfort.en: Waiting for the right person can feel lonely and long. Musa (AS) sat under a tree, tired and alone, and said "My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send me", and Allah sent him a family.
comfort.hi: Sahi insaan ka intezaar lamba aur akela lag sakta hai. Musa (AS) ek ped ke neeche thake aur akele baithe the aur kaha "Aye Rab, jo bhalaai tu bheje main uska mohtaaj hoon", aur Allah ne unhe ghar aur parivaar diya.

verse.en: And of His signs is that He created for you spouses that you may find tranquillity in them.
verse.hi: Uski nishaniyon mein se hai ki usne tumhare liye jode banaye taaki tum unse sukoon pao.

comfort.en: A home with conflict is exhausting, especially when you still care. Allah placed love and mercy between spouses, and He can soften hearts that seem hard. Ask Him to make your home a source of comfort again.
comfort.hi: Jhagdon waala ghar thaka deta hai, khaaskar jab aapko ab bhi parwah ho. Allah ne miyan biwi ke beech mohabbat aur rehmat rakhi hai, aur woh sakht dilon ko bhi narm kar sakta hai. Usse maango ki ghar phir se sukoon ki jagah ban jaaye.

verse.en: And He placed between you affection and mercy.
verse.hi: Aur usne tumhare beech mohabbat aur rehmat rakh di.

comfort.en: Worrying for your children is a form of love. You can guide them, but only Allah can place goodness in their hearts, so place them in His care, morning and evening.
comfort.hi: Bachchon ki fikr bhi mohabbat ka ek roop hai. Aap unhe raah dikha sakte ho, par unke dil mein bhalaai sirf Allah daal sakta hai, isliye subah shaam unhe uski hifaazat mein de do.

verse.en: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes.
verse.hi: Aye hamare Rab, hamein hamari biwiyon aur aulaad se aankhon ki thandak ata kar.

comfort.en: Longing for a child is a quiet ache that few people see. Zakariyya (AS) was old and his wife was barren, yet he kept calling, "Do not leave me alone", and Allah gave him Yahya.
comfort.hi: Aulad ki chaahat ek khamosh dard hai jo kam log dekhte hain. Zakariyya (AS) boodhe the aur unki biwi baanjh thi, phir bhi woh pukaarte rahe "mujhe akela na chhod", aur Allah ne unhe Yahya diye.

verse.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.
verse.hi: Aye mere Rab, mujhe akela na chhod, aur tu sabse behtar waaris hai.

comfort.en: Caring about your parents is among the most beloved deeds to Allah. Whatever is happening with them, your dua for them is a gift that never stops reaching them.
comfort.hi: Maa baap ki parwah Allah ke sabse pasandeeda aamaal mein se hai. Unke saath jo bhi ho raha ho, unke liye aapki dua aisa tohfa hai jo unhe hamesha pahunchta rehta hai.

verse.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
verse.hi: Aye mere Rab, un dono par reham farma jaise unhone mujhe bachpan mein paala.

comfort.en: Being in pain is hard on the body and the heart. Ayyub (AS) suffered for years and only said "harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful". Every ache you bear patiently wipes away sins.
comfort.hi: Dard jism aur dil dono ko thaka deta hai. Ayyub (AS) saalon takleef mein rahe aur bas kaha "mujhe takleef pahunchi hai aur tu sabse zyada reham karne wala hai". Sabr se sahi har takleef gunah mita deti hai.

verse.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.
verse.hi: Aur jab main beemar hota hoon toh wahi mujhe shifa deta hai.

comfort.en: When the night feels long, Allah is awake: He neither slumbers nor sleeps. Hand Him the thoughts that keep you up, recite Ayat al-Kursi, and let your heart lie down with His name.
comfort.hi: Jab raat lambi lage, Allah jaag raha hai: use na oongh aati hai na neend. Jo khayaal aapko jagaate hain woh use saunp do, Ayatul Kursi padho, aur uska naam lekar dil ko aaraam do.

verse.en: Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.
verse.hi: Use na oongh aati hai na neend.

label.en: worried about evil eye or harm
label.hi: nazar, jaadu ya nuksaan ka darr

comfort.en: It's natural to worry about harm you can't see. But nothing and no one can harm you except by Allah's permission. Wrap yourself in His words every morning and evening, and trust His protection.
comfort.hi: Jo nuksaan dikhta nahi uski fikr hona fitri hai. Par Allah ki ijaazat ke bina koi cheez aur koi shakhs aapko nuksaan nahi pahuncha sakta. Subah shaam uske kalaam ki panaah lo, aur uski hifaazat par bharosa rakho.

verse.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created.
verse.hi: Kaho: main subah ke Rab ki panaah maangta hoon, uski banaayi hui har cheez ki buraai se.

comfort.en: A journey is a time when duas are accepted. Put your trip, your family and everything you leave behind in Allah's care; nothing left with Him is ever lost.
comfort.hi: Safar mein duaein qubool hoti hain. Apna safar, apna parivaar aur jo kuch peeche chhod rahe ho sab Allah ke hawaale kar do; jo uske paas amaanat rakha jaaye woh kabhi zaaya nahi hota.

verse.en: Glory be to the One who has placed this at our service, and we could not have done it ourselves.
verse.hi: Paak hai woh jisne ise hamare liye taabe kar diya, warna hum ise kaabu na kar paate.

label.hi: ghar ya naye ghar ki baat

comfort.en: A home is more than walls; it's where your heart rests. Ask Allah for a blessed place to settle, the way Nuh (AS) did, and fill it with His remembrance.
comfort.hi: Ghar sirf deewaron ka naam nahi, yeh dil ke aaraam ki jagah hai. Nuh (AS) ki tarah Allah se barakat waali jagah maango, aur use uske zikr se bhar do.

verse.en: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate us.
verse.hi: Aye mere Rab, mujhe barakat waali jagah utaar, aur tu sabse behtar utaarne wala hai.

label.en: unmotivated or stuck in bad habits
label.hi: susti ya buri aadaton mein phansa

comfort.en: Feeling stuck doesn't mean you're a bad person; it means you need help, and the Prophet ﷺ himself asked Allah for refuge from laziness. Start with one small deed done consistently; that's what Allah loves most.
comfort.hi: Phansa hua mehsoos karna bura insaan hone ki nishani nahi; iska matlab hai aapko madad chahiye, aur Nabi ﷺ ne khud susti se Allah ki panaah maangi. Ek chhota amal roz karo; Allah ko wahi sabse pasand hai.

verse.en: Those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
verse.hi: Jo hamare liye koshish karte hain, hum unhe zaroor apne raaste dikha dete hain.

comfort.en: Even the Companions felt whispers that troubled them, and the Prophet ﷺ said that hating such thoughts is clear faith. Keep asking Allah to make your heart firm; He is the Turner of hearts.
comfort.hi: Sahaba ko bhi aise waswase aate the jo unhe pareshaan karte, aur Nabi ﷺ ne farmaaya ki unhe bura samajhna khud saaf imaan hai. Allah se dil ki mazbooti maangte raho; wahi dilon ko pherne wala hai.

verse.en: Whoever believes in Allah, He will guide his heart.
verse.hi: Jo Allah par imaan laaye, Allah uske dil ko hidaayat deta hai.

comfort.en: Alhamdulillah! Remember this moment, because Allah promised more to those who thank Him. Turn your happiness into shukr so the blessing stays and grows.
comfort.hi: Alhamdulillah! Is lamhe ko yaad rakhna, kyunki Allah ne shukr karne waalon ko aur dene ka waada kiya hai. Apni khushi ko shukr mein badlo taaki naimat bani rahe aur badhe.

verse.en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
verse.hi: Agar tum shukr karoge toh main tumhe aur zyada dunga.

comfort.en: Real peace doesn't come from having everything; it comes from being pleased with the One who gives everything. Remember Him often, and your heart will find the rest it's searching for.
comfort.hi: Asal sukoon sab kuch hone se nahi aata; woh us Zaat se raazi hone se aata hai jo sab kuch deta hai. Use kasrat se yaad karo, aapka dil woh aaraam paa lega jise woh dhoondh raha hai.

verse.en: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
verse.hi: Suno, Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko sukoon milta hai.

label.en: thinking about death and the hereafter

comfort.en: Thinking about the akhirah is a sign of a living heart. Allah's mercy outweighs His anger, and He wants Jannah for you more than you want it for yourself. Ask Him for it often.
comfort.hi: Aakhirat ki soch zinda dil ki nishani hai. Allah ki rehmat uske gusse par ghaalib hai, aur woh aapke liye Jannat aapse zyada chahta hai. Usse baar baar Jannat maango.

verse.en: Race towards forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth.
verse.hi: Apne Rab ki maghfirat aur us Jannat ki taraf daudo jiski chaudaai aasmaan aur zameen jitni hai.

comfort.en: Whatever you're carrying right now, Allah already knows it, even the parts you can't put into words. Start with these duas and tell Him the rest in your own language; He understands every one.
comfort.hi: Aap abhi jo bhi utha rahe ho, Allah pehle se jaanta hai, woh hissa bhi jo lafzon mein nahi aata. In duaon se shuru karo aur baaqi apni zabaan mein keh do; woh har zabaan samajhta hai.

verse.en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
verse.hi: Mujhe pukaaro, main tumhari dua qubool karunga.
